bank.stem: A US contract site, inspected by FDA with an acceptable outcome, will start supplying a biologic to an EU importer. The importer's management hopes the EU–US MRA removes the need for EU batch certification. What is correct?
options: The MRA removes EU inspection of the US site and the importer's QP certification, leaving the MIA as the remaining duty.
The MRA waives QP certification, but each imported batch must still be fully retested on EU soil.
The MRA lets the EU rely on FDA's inspection and waives batch retesting, but the importer's QP must still certify.
The MRA covers inspection outcomes, so full EU retesting of each batch and QP certification both still apply.
bank.expl:
- C: MRA로 EU NCA는 FDA 사찰 결과를 자체 사찰 대신 인정하고 Art 51(1)(b) 배치 재시험이 면제된다. 수입자 MIA와 QP 인증(Annex 16)은 남는다.
- A: QP 인증은 생략할 수 없다.
- B: 면제되는 쪽은 재시험이고 QP 인증은 남는다. 반대로 적었다.
- D: MRA는 재시험 면제를 포함한다.

bank.title: QP versus the quality unit
bank.stem: Compare the Qualified Person with the US quality unit under 21 CFR 211.22. Which statement best captures where legal responsibility sits?
options: The QP is an organisation-level function, while the quality unit is an individual licensed by FDA.
The QP signs a register for each batch as an individual with personal liability; the quality unit is organisational.
The QP certifies batches imported from outside the EU, whereas the quality unit approves batches made in the US.
Both carry personal criminal liability for each batch, defined directly in the FD&C Act and in Directive 2001/83/EC.
bank.expl:
- B: QP(Art 48–52, Annex 16)는 개인이 배치마다 등록부에 서명하고 위반 시 개인 징계·형사 책임(회원국 법)을 진다. 211.22 quality unit은 조직의 승인·거부 권한이며 개인 면허가 없다.
- A: 둘을 뒤바꿨다.
- C: QP는 EU 출하 배치 전반을 인증한다. 수입 배치에 한정되지 않는다.
- D: quality unit은 조직의 책임이다. QP의 개인 책임은 회원국 법이 정한다.

bank.title: QP reporting line
bank.stem: A global company plans to have its EU QP report to the site's production director to speed up batch release. Why is this structure a problem?
options: The QP must report to the MAH's legal department, which is the reporting line that Annex 16 assigns.
The QP must be able to refuse batches independently, which needs separation from production lines.
The QP must be employed by the national competent authority, so a company reporting line is not permitted.
The QP must also hold a US quality unit appointment, so dual reporting to production is required by the MRA.
bank.expl:
- B: QP는 독립적으로 거부할 수 있어야 하므로 조직도에서 생산·사업 보고선과 분리한다.
- A: Annex 16이 법무 보고선을 정하지 않는다.
- C: QP는 회사의 사람이다. 당국 소속이 아니다.
- D: MRA는 QP에게 미국 직책을 요구하지 않는다.

bank.title: QP reliance on external sites
bank.stem: An EU importer's QP certifies batches made at a contract site in a third country and tested at an external laboratory. The QP has never visited either site. What does the QP need to document?
options: Nothing beyond the certificate of analysis, since the importer's MIA covers third-country sites.
A signed statement from the CMO's quality head, which transfers certification duty to the CMO.
A basis for relying on each site, such as audits and quality agreements, under Annex 16 §1.7.
Copies of the sites' business supply contracts, which serve as the quality agreement for GMP.
bank.expl:
- C: QP가 의존하는 외부 사이트는 감사·quality agreement로 신뢰 근거를 문서화한다(Annex 16 §1.7).
- A: MIA는 수입자 허가다. 제3국 사이트의 GMP 근거를 대신하지 않는다.
- B: 인증 책임은 CMO로 넘어가지 않는다.
- D: quality agreement는 사업 계약과 분리한다.

bank.title: PAI objectives
bank.stem: Which three objectives define FDA's pre-approval inspection program under CPGM 7346.832 (2022 revision)?
options: Quality system, facilities and equipment, and laboratory control, as in the six-system model.
Clinical site monitoring, investigator records review, and application data conformance.
Commercial manufacturing readiness, pricing review, and post-marketing commitment status.
Commercial manufacturing readiness, conformance to the application, and a data integrity audit.
bank.expl:
- D: 7346.832의 3 objectives는 상업 생산 준비도, 신청서 일치, data integrity 감사다.
- A: 6-system은 7356.002 surveillance 사찰의 틀이다.
- B: 임상 현장 점검은 PAI의 세 목표에 없다.
- C: 가격·PMC 현황은 목표에 없다.

bank.title: inspection type from recall signals
bank.stem: A marketed product has had three Class II recalls this year, and Field Alert Reports from the same site keep rising. FDA schedules an inspection focused on the problem systems. What type of inspection is this?
options: A for-cause inspection driven by recall and FAR signals.
A pre-approval inspection under CPGM 7346.832.
A follow-up inspection to close out a Warning Letter.
A routine surveillance inspection on the fixed cycle.
bank.expl:
- A: 리콜·FAR·불만 신호에 따른 사찰은 for-cause다. 7356.002 틀에 문제 시스템을 집중한다.
- B: PAI는 pending 신청이 대상이다.
- C: follow-up은 WL 후 CAPA 확인이다. 여기엔 WL이 없다.
- D: surveillance는 위험 기반 정기 사찰이고, 고정 주기는 FDASIA §705로 폐지됐다.

bank.title: required system in surveillance
bank.stem: An FDA surveillance inspection of a solid-dose plant will cover a subset of systems under CPGM 7356.002. The site's readiness team wants to know which system it must prepare in every case. Which is right?
options: Laboratory Control, because data integrity is audited at each visit.
The Quality system, which is required, plus at least one other system.
Packaging & Labeling, since mislabeling drives most drug recalls.
Production, which is the core system in each surveillance inspection.
bank.expl:
- B: 7356.002의 6-system 중 Quality는 필수이고, 그 외 1개 이상을 본다.
- A·C·D: 모두 6-system의 하나지만 필수 시스템은 Quality다.

bank.title: failed PAI
bank.stem: An NDA names a new contract manufacturer. At the pre-approval inspection FDA finds that the site's batch records do not match the CMC section and that it is not ready for commercial production. The review is otherwise complete. What should the sponsor expect?
options: An Untitled Letter to the sponsor, with approval held until the CMO responds.
Approval with a post-marketing requirement to fix the site within one year.
A Complete Response letter, because the facility is not adequate for approval.
Approval, because the PAI result binds the CMO rather than the application.
bank.expl:
- C: PAI 목표(상업 생산 준비도·신청서 일치)를 통과하지 못하면 CR letter(시설 미적합)다.
- A: Untitled Letter는 경미한 사안의 행정 서신이다. PAI 실패의 결과가 아니다.
- B: 시설 결함은 CR 사유다. 승인 후 요건으로 넘기지 않는다.
- D: CMO의 시설 결과가 신청의 승인을 막는다(200.10(b) 공동 책임).

bank.title: nature of Form 483
bank.stem: What is a Form 483?
options: The establishment inspection report that classifies the site as NAI, VAI or OAI.
The written notice of inspection that the investigator presents on arrival at the site.
FDA's final determination that a site violates CGMP, issued after headquarters review.
A list of the investigator's observations, handed over at the close of an inspection.
bank.expl:
- D: 483은 사찰 종료 시 주는 관찰사항 목록이고 최종 결정이 아니다.
- A: EIR과 분류는 483 뒤에 온다.
- B: 도착 시 통지는 Form 482다.
- C: 최종 판단이 아니다. 분류와 후속 조치는 따로 정해진다.

bank.title: Form 483 response clock
bank.stem: A Form 483 is issued on the last day of an inspection. The site head tells the team they have "about two weeks, counting weekends" to respond. What is the response window FDA considers before deciding on a Warning Letter?
options: 30 calendar days, after which the response is placed on the public inspection docket.
15 calendar days, counted from the date the establishment inspection report is finalised.
15 business days from issuance, with weekends and holidays excluded from the count.
15 working days, which differ from business days because Saturdays are counted.
bank.expl:
- C: 483 응답은 15 business days이고, 기한 내 응답은 WL 결정 전에 검토된다(2009 FR 고지). 함정은 영업일과 달력일의 차이다.
- A: 달력일 기준도, 공개 문서함 절차도 근거가 없다.
- B: 달력일이 아니고, 기산점도 EIR 확정이 아니다.
- D: business days와 working days는 같은 영업일이다. 토요일을 세지 않는다.

bank.title: NAI, VAI, OAI
bank.stem: In FDA practice, which statement about NAI, VAI and OAI is correct?
options: They classify the whole site; OAI means regulatory action is recommended.
They are EU deficiency grades that FDA adopted under the EU–US MRA.
VAI means the firm volunteered corrections, so the Form 483 is withdrawn.
They grade each Form 483 observation individually, from minor to critical.
bank.expl:
- A: NAI/VAI/OAI는 사이트 전체 분류다. OAI는 규제 조치 권고이고 WL·Import Alert·승인 보류를 촉발한다.
- B: EU는 critical/major/other를 쓴다.
- C: VAI는 483 철회를 뜻하지 않는다.
- D: 개별 483 관찰엔 공식 등급이 없다. 결함별 등급(critical/major/other)은 EU 방식이다.

bank.title: Warning Letter response clock
bank.stem: A Warning Letter arrives at a US plant. A new hire drafts a response timeline of 15 calendar days, arguing that the "working days" in the letter count weekends, unlike the "business days" used for Form 483 responses. How should the timeline be corrected?
options: Keep 15 calendar days, because working days count weekends while business days do not.
Count 15 calendar days, because a public Warning Letter shortens the window.
Count 30 working days, because a Warning Letter allows longer than a Form 483.
Count 15 working days, the same unit as business days, so weekends are excluded.
bank.expl:
- D: WL 응답은 15 working days다. working days와 business days는 같은 영업일이고, 달력일로 센 것이 틀렸다.
- A: working days가 주말을 포함한다는 구분은 없다.
- B: 공개 여부가 기한 단위를 바꾸지 않는다.
- C: WL 응답 기한도 15 working days다. 483보다 길지 않다.

bank.title: US escalation ladder
bank.stem: Which sequence reflects the escalation of US enforcement after a CGMP inspection?
options: Warning Letter → Form 483 → Import Alert → site classification → consent decree → criminal prosecution.
Form 483 → site classification → Warning Letter → Import Alert → seizure or injunction → prosecution.
Site classification → Form 483 → consent decree → Warning Letter → Import Alert → seizure.
Form 483 → Import Alert → site classification → prosecution → Warning Letter → seizure.
bank.expl:
- B: 483 → EIR·NAI/VAI/OAI → Untitled/Warning Letter → Import Alert(DWPE) → seizure(304)·injunction(302)·consent decree → 303 형사 순이다.
- A: 483이 WL보다 먼저 온다.
- C: 분류는 483 뒤에 오고, consent decree는 WL·Import Alert 뒤 단계다.
- D: 분류가 Import Alert보다 먼저이고, 형사는 맨 끝이다.

bank.title: shipment under Import Alert 66-40
bank.stem: A finished-dose plant in Korea is classified OAI and placed on Import Alert 66-40. A US distributor asks the sponsor's regulatory team what will happen to the next shipment at the US border.
options: It is admitted, though the plant's pending applications are placed on hold by FDA.
It is seized under section 304 at the port of entry, and destroyed after the court rules on the case.
It is detained without physical examination, and the importer may present evidence before refusal.
It is sampled and tested by FDA, and released if the batch meets its specifications.
bank.expl:
- C: Import Alert 66-40은 DWPE다. 입항 시 자동 억류되고, 반증 기회 후 실패하면 801(a) refusal이다.
- A: 신청 보류가 병행될 수 있지만 선적은 억류된다.
- B: seizure(304)는 별도의 사법 조치다.
- D: 물리적 검사 없이 억류한다. 규격 합격 여부로 풀리지 않는다.

bank.title: Park doctrine
bank.stem: A company's vice president of operations had authority to correct recurring CGMP violations but did not act. She did not know of any specific shipment of violative product. Under US law, can she face criminal liability?
options: Yes; under Park, a responsible corporate officer can be liable without intent.
Yes, provided a prior Warning Letter had named her personally as responsible.
No; the company answers through a consent decree, which shields its officers.
No; misdemeanor liability under section 303(a) requires proof of intent to defraud.
bank.expl:
- A: US v. Park(1975)·303(a)에 따라 책임 있는 임원은 고의 없이도 개인 책임(경범)을 진다.
- B: WL 지명은 요건이 아니다.
- C: consent decree는 오히려 임원을 피고로 명시한다.
- D: 고의·사기는 303 중범 쪽 요건이다.

bank.title: strengthening a 483 response
bank.stem: A Form 483 cites a failure to investigate a deviation on one filling line. The site plans to answer by retraining the one operator involved and closing the item. What improves the response most?
options: Extending the root cause to other products and lines, with CAPA, timelines and an effectiveness check.
Waiting for the inspection report before answering, so the response addresses the final classification.
Retraining the operator and adding a signed attestation that the deviation will not recur.
Disputing the observation in full, because a single-line event cannot support a CGMP finding.
bank.expl:
- A: 항목별 근본 원인 → CAPA → 일정 → 효과성 확인, 그리고 개별 사례를 시스템 전체로 확장하는 것이 기대 수준이다.
- B: 기다리면 15 business days를 넘겨 WL 판단 전에 검토되지 않는다.
- C: 개인 재교육과 약속만으로는 시스템 교정을 보여주지 못한다.
- D: 사실 오류가 있을 때 근거로 반박한다. 단일 사례라는 이유로 전면 부정할 근거는 없다.

bank.title: 483 and distributed batches
bank.stem: A Form 483 includes a data integrity observation affecting release tests for batches already distributed under an approved NDA. While drafting the 483 response, which notification question must the team also settle?
options: Whether a Field Alert Report is due within 3 working days for the distributed batches.
Whether a BPDR is due within 45 days, which is the NDA defect reporting route.
Whether to wait for the Warning Letter, which starts the defect reporting clock.
Whether to notify the EU QP within 90 days under Article 111(5) of Directive 2001/83/EC.
bank.expl:
- A: 출하 배치의 제품 영향 평가와 함께 FAR(3 working days, 314.81) 필요성을 판단한다.
- B: BPDR(45일, 600.14)은 BLA 경로다. NDA는 FAR이다.
- C: 보고 의무는 WL을 기다리지 않는다.
- D: 111(5)의 90일은 NCA의 GMP 인증서 발급 기한이다.

bank.title: disputes and long CAPAs
bank.stem: A site disagrees with one Form 483 observation, which misstates the lot number tested, and has a CAPA for another item that will take nine months to complete. How should these be handled in the response?
options: Accept each observation to avoid conflict, and promise to finish each CAPA within the 15-business-day window.
Rebut the factual error with evidence, and commit to an achievable date with later update responses.
Ask FDA to delete the observation before responding, and file the CAPA plan with the annual report.
Omit the disputed item, and leave the long CAPA out of the response until it has been finished.
bank.expl:
- B: 사실 오류는 근거로 반박하고, 약속은 지킬 수 있는 날짜만 쓰고 이후 업데이트 응답을 낸다.
- A: 15 business days는 응답 제출 기한이지 CAPA 완료 기한이 아니다.
- C: 삭제 요청을 응답의 전제로 삼을 근거가 없고, 연차 보고는 483 응답 경로가 아니다.
- D: 항목을 빠뜨리면 응답이 불완전해진다. 긴 CAPA도 일정과 함께 제시한다.

bank.title: mandatory RRA
bank.stem: FDA sends a US manufacturer a request under section 704(a)(4) for batch records and deviation logs "in advance of or in lieu of an inspection." The CEO suggests declining, since no investigator is on site. What should the regulatory lead advise?
options: Treat it as a voluntary RRA; the firm may choose a livestream instead of sending documents.
Comply in a reasonable time; refusing or delaying a mandatory RRA makes drugs adulterated under 501(j).
Provide the records once a Form 483 lists them, because 704(a)(4) applies after an inspection.
Declining is safe, because a remote request cannot lead to enforcement unless an investigator is on site.
bank.expl:
- B: 704(a)(4) 요구는 mandatory RRA다(RRA guidance 2025-06-26). 211 기록을 합리적 기한 내 제출해야 하고, 거부·지연·제한은 501(j) adulterated다.
- A: 동의 기반 voluntary RRA와 다르다.
- C: 704(a)(4)는 사찰 전·대신 하는 요구다.
- D: 현장 사찰이 없어도 501(j) 효과가 생긴다.

bank.title: voluntary RRA
bank.stem: Under FDA's 2025 guidance on remote regulatory assessments, what is true of a voluntary RRA?
options: It is consent-based; declining is not sanctioned in itself, though FDA may inspect.
Its findings cannot be used in inspection classification or written observations.
It rests on 704(a)(4), so declining makes the drugs adulterated under 501(j).
It is limited to US sites, because foreign sites must be inspected in person.
bank.expl:
- A: voluntary RRA는 동의 기반(원격 평가·livestream·인터뷰)이다. 거부 자체엔 제재가 없지만 사찰로 전환될 수 있다.
- B: RRA 결과는 사찰 분류와 관찰 서면에 쓰일 수 있다.
- C: 704(a)(4)·501(j)는 mandatory RRA 쪽이다.
- D: 해외 사이트도 RRA 대상이다.

bank.title: RRA guidance status
bank.stem: As of 2026-09-01, what is the status of FDA's guidance on remote regulatory assessments?
options: A final Q&A guidance issued on 2025-06-26, revising the 2024 draft.
A pilot programme limited to India and China, announced in May 2025.
A draft issued in January 2024, with public comments still under review.
A final rule codified in 21 CFR 211, effective from 2025-06-26.
bank.expl:
- A: RRA Q&A 최종 guidance는 2025-06-26이고 2024-01 초안을 개정했다.
- B: 인도·중국 pilot은 불시 사찰 이야기이고, 2025-05 발표는 해외 불시 사찰 확대다.
- C: 2024-01은 초안이고 이미 최종화됐다.
- D: 규정이 아니라 guidance다.

bank.title: unannounced foreign inspections
bank.stem: A Korean API plant used to receive months of notice before FDA inspections, and staff "tidied" records in the weeks before each visit. FDA expanded unannounced foreign inspections in May 2025. Why does this change matter most for the plant's compliance risk?
options: Unannounced visits are limited to for-cause inspections, so routine readiness work can continue as before.
Pre-inspection record clean-up becomes a data integrity risk, so the site must stay inspection-ready.
Section 704 now requires prior notice for domestic sites, so foreign sites gain the advantage instead.
Unannounced inspections cannot result in Form 483 observations, which removes the main enforcement trigger.
bank.expl:
- B: 2025-05 발표(인도·중국 pilot 후)로 해외도 불시 사찰이 확대됐다. 준비 기간이 없으니 상시 준비 상태가 필요하고, 사찰 전 기록 '정리' 관행은 data integrity 위험으로 바뀐다.
- A: for-cause 한정이라는 근거는 없다.
- C: 704는 원래 사전 통지 의무가 없고, 국내는 늘 불시였다.
- D: 결과 사다리는 같다(483 → 분류 → WL/Import Alert).

bank.title: SOP update for unannounced visits
bank.stem: After the 2025 policy change, a Korean site's regulatory lead revises its SOPs for unannounced FDA inspections. Which set of changes best fits the expected readiness?
options: A request to FDA for two weeks' notice, a document review period, and a rehearsal before entry.
A rule that the plant may defer the inspection to the next business day if senior staff are away.
A policy to share records after a written 704(a)(4) request, to keep the visit within its scope.
Instant document access, English SOP summaries, standing interpreters and a set entry procedure.
bank.expl:
- D: 즉시 열람, 영어 SOP 요약·통역 상시, 입장 절차 사전 정비가 운영 변화다.
- A: 불시 사찰엔 준비 기간이 없다.
- B: 사찰 지연은 501(j) adulterated 사유다.
- C: 현장 사찰의 기록 열람을 서면 요구까지 미루면 사찰 제한이 된다(501(j)).

bank.title: MRA completion date
bank.stem: On what date did the EU–US MRA on GMP inspections for human medicines become fully operational, with FDA recognising the last EU Member State?
options: 2011-01-01, when FDA joined PIC/S and began to accept EU inspections.
2019-07-11, when FDA recognised Slovakia, the last Member State.
2023-05-31, when recognition was completed across the Member States.
2019-07-12, the date the MRA entered into force for human medicines.
bank.expl:
- B: 인체용 MRA는 FDA가 슬로바키아를 인정한 2019-07-11에 전 회원국 인정이 끝났다.
- A: 2011-01-01은 FDA의 PIC/S 가입일이고, PIC/S는 법적 MRA가 아니다.
- C: 2023-05-31은 동물용 합의(Decision 2536/2023)다.
- D: 07-12는 EMA 뉴스 게시일이다. 운영 완성일이 아니다.

bank.title: Article 51 under the MRA
bank.stem: An EU importer receives a batch of a human medicine made at an FDA-inspected US plant. The importer's quality team asks which Article 51 step changes under the EU–US MRA.
options: Full retesting under Article 51(1)(b) is waived; the QP still certifies the batch after reviewing test records.
Neither changes, because the MRA covers inspection outcomes and leaves the Article 51 duties untouched.
Both retesting and QP certification are waived, and the batch is released on FDA's inspection classification.
QP certification is waived under the MRA, but the importer retests the batch in full on arrival under Article 51(1)(b).
bank.expl:
- A: MRA로 Art 51(1)(b)의 EU 내 전수 재시험이 면제되고(제조 시 시험 기록 확인), QP 배치 인증(Annex 16)은 남는다.
- B: MRA는 재시험 면제를 포함한다.
- C: QP 인증은 생략할 수 없다.
- D: 면제와 의무가 뒤바뀌었다.

bank.title: MRA scope
bank.stem: Which statement about the scope of the EU–US MRA on GMP is correct as of 2026-09-01?
options: Veterinary medicines were part of the original 2019 human-medicine scope, and vaccines were covered from the outset.
Veterinary medicines were added on 2023-05-31; vaccines and plasma-derived products were initially out of scope.
It covers clinical trial inspections as well as GMP, and Member State recognition for both ended in 2019.
It covers human medicines and medical devices together, with veterinary medicines left to national agreements.
bank.expl:
- B: 동물용은 2023-05-31 합의(Decision 2536/2023)로 확대됐고, 백신·혈장 유래 제품은 인체용 초기 범위에서 제외됐다.
- A: 동물용은 2023년 합의로 들어왔다.
- C: 이 MRA는 GMP 사찰 상호 인정이다.
- D: 이 MRA는 의약품 GMP 사찰 인정이고, 동물용도 MRA 안에서 합의됐다.

bank.title: ICH Q7 in the two regions
bank.stem: How does ICH Q7 enter the US and EU GMP frameworks?
options: As EU Part III and as an FDA final rule for APIs.
As EU Annex 1 and as FDA's aseptic processing standard.
As EU Part I and as a binding part of 21 CFR 211.
As EU Part II and as FDA guidance, setting GMP for APIs.
bank.expl:
- D: Q7(2000)은 API GMP로, EU에선 Part II, FDA에선 guidance다.
- A: Part III는 SMF·Q9·Q10 등이고, FDA에서 Q7은 규정이 아니다.
- B: Annex 1은 무균 제조 부록이다.
- C: Part I은 완제이고, 211이 API에 직접 적용되지 않는다.

bank.title: ICH Q9(R1)
bank.stem: What did the 2023 revision of ICH Q9, Q9(R1), add to quality risk management?
options: A replacement of risk assessment with continued process verification.
Guidance on subjectivity, formality, and risks to product availability.
Mandatory use of FMEA for sterile manufacturing risks across sites.
A requirement for quantitative risk scores in each PQS process.
bank.expl:
- B: Q9(R1)(2023-01)은 주관성, 형식성 수준, 제품 가용성 위험을 추가했다.
- A: CPV는 공정 검증의 Stage 3 개념이다. 위험 평가를 대체하지 않는다.
- C·D: 추가 내용은 주관성·형식성·가용성 세 가지다. 점수나 특정 도구를 의무화한 개정이 아니다.

bank.title: ICH Q10 elements
bank.stem: Which list gives the four PQS elements of ICH Q10?
options: Process design; process performance qualification; continued process verification; change control.
Process performance and product quality monitoring; CAPA; change management; management review.
Quality unit; batch record review; annual product review; complaint handling.
Risk assessment; risk control; risk communication; risk review.
bank.expl:
- B: Q10(2008) PQS 4요소는 공정 성능·제품 품질 모니터링, CAPA, 변경 관리, 경영 검토다.
- A: FDA PV 2011의 3 Stage에 변경 관리를 붙인 것이다.
- C: 211 쪽 요소들이다.
- D: Q9 QRM의 과정이다.

bank.title: management review gap
bank.stem: A site's quality metrics show rising deviation rates for six months, but senior leaders see them in a yearly summary and take no action. An inspector notes this. Which ICH Q10 element is weakest?
options: Product quality monitoring, which Q10 assigns to the QP rather than to management.
Management review, which should regularly bring PQS performance to senior management.
Risk communication, a Q10 element that takes the place of management involvement.
Change management, because deviations should be processed as change requests.
bank.expl:
- B: 경영 검토는 Q10 4요소 중 하나로, PQS 성과를 경영진이 검토하고 조치하게 한다.
- A: Q10은 모니터링을 QP에게 배정하지 않는다.
- C: risk communication은 Q9 과정이다. Q10 요소가 아니다.
- D: 편차를 변경으로 처리하는 것은 핵심이 아니다. 경영진이 성과를 보고도 움직이지 않는 것이 결함이다.

bank.title: correcting a PIC/S description
bank.stem: A regulatory lead describes PIC/S to a new team as "a legally binding mutual recognition agreement that FDA joined in 2019." What should be corrected?
options: PIC/S is a legal MRA as stated, but its GMP guide PE 009 departs from EU GMP in content.
PIC/S is an EU agency under EMA, and FDA takes part as an observer rather than a member.
PIC/S is a cooperation network, not a legal MRA, and FDA joined it on 2011-01-01.
PIC/S is binding as stated, but FDA became a member in 1995 when PIC was converted into PIC/S.
bank.expl:
- C: PIC/S(PIC 1970 → 1995)는 사찰 당국 간 조화·교육·상호 신뢰 네트워크이고 법적 MRA가 아니다. FDA는 2011-01-01에 가입했다.
- A: PE 009는 EU GMP와 같은 내용이다.
- B: EU 기구가 아니다.
- D: 1995는 PIC/S 출범 연도다.

bank.title: one readiness programme
bank.stem: A company is inspected by FDA, several EU authorities and other PIC/S members. Its QA head asks whether to build separate inspection-readiness programmes for each authority. What is the best analysis?
options: One programme suffices for EU authorities, but FDA does not take part in PIC/S and needs its own.
Separate programmes are required, because PIC/S members inspect against unrelated national GMP texts.
Separate programmes are required, because PIC/S forbids sharing inspection reports among members.
One programme can serve most authorities, because PIC/S members apply the same GMP guide and checklists.
bank.expl:
- D: PIC/S 가입국 사찰은 같은 기준(PE 009 = EU GMP)과 같은 체크리스트라 한 준비가 다른 당국에도 통한다.
- A: FDA는 2011년에 가입했다.
- B: PE 009가 공통 가이드다.
- C: PIC/S는 사찰 보고서와 rapid alert 정보를 공유한다.

bank.title: ALCOA+
bank.stem: In ALCOA+, which attributes are added to the original five?
options: Controlled, Compliant, Encrypted, Approved.
Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available.
Certified, Consistent, Exportable, Archived.
Complete, Correct, Electronic, Audited.
bank.expl:
- B: ALCOA+는 Attributable·Legible·Contemporaneous·Original·Accurate에 Complete·Consistent·Enduring·Available을 더한다.
- A·C·D: 더해지는 네 속성이 아니다.

bank.title: audit trail convergence
bank.stem: FDA, MHRA, PIC/S and WHO data integrity documents all stress audit trail review. What explains this convergence?
options: Audit trails remove the need for second-person review of results, which reduces inspection workload.
Audit trail review is the single ALCOA+ attribute that regulators in each region have written into law.
In electronic records the audit trail is the only trace of changes, so it is verifiable evidence of reliability.
Audit trails are also required for paper records, so they give one common practice for paper and electronic data.
bank.expl:
- C: 종이 기록은 조작이 흔적을 남기지만 전자 기록은 audit trail이 유일한 흔적이다. 그래서 audit trail 활성·주기 검토·메타데이터 보존(211.68/Annex 11 §9)이 검증 가능한 최소 증거다.
- A: 결과 검토를 대체하지 않는다. audit trail 자체를 주기적으로 검토한다.
- B: audit trail은 ALCOA+ 속성이 아니다.
- D: 종이 기록은 조작이 흔적을 남긴다는 점이 대비점이다.

bank.title: data integrity documents
bank.stem: Which pairing of data integrity document and year is correct?
options: PIC/S PI 041-1 — 2011; MHRA GxP data integrity — 2023.
MHRA GxP data integrity — 2021; FDA data integrity Q&A — 2014.
WHO TRS 1033 Annex 4 — 2014; PIC/S PI 041-1 — 2018.
FDA data integrity Q&A — 2018; PIC/S PI 041-1 — 2021.
bank.expl:
- D: FDA Q&A는 2018-12, PIC/S PI 041-1은 2021-07-01이다. MHRA는 2018-03, WHO TRS 1033 Annex 4는 2021이다.
- A: 2011은 FDA의 PIC/S 가입 연도다.
- B: MHRA는 2018이다.
- C: WHO data integrity는 2021이다. 2014는 WHO GMP TRS 986이다.

bank.title: WHO GMP and procurement
bank.stem: A manufacturer of an antimalarial wants to supply a Global Fund procurement programme. Which GMP framework will define its inspection standard?
options: WHO GMP, used for the WHO Prequalification inspections that procurement relies on.
ICH Q10, since procurement agencies inspect the quality system rather than GMP.
EudraLex Part IV, the standard applied to medicines supplied outside the EU.
21 CFR 211, which WHO adopted as its main GMP text in its 2014 revision.
bank.expl:
- A: WHO GMP(TRS 986 Annex 2, 2014)는 WHO PQ 사찰 기준이고, HIV·결핵·말라리아·백신 등 Global Fund·UNICEF 조달의 전제다.
- B: Q10은 PQS 모델이다.
- C: Part IV는 ATMP GMP다.
- D: TRS 986은 WHO 자체 텍스트다.

bank.title: Annex 1 timeline
bank.stem: A German site making a lyophilised sterile product asks when revised EU GMP Annex 1 applied to it and what new document it must hold. Which answer is right?
options: From 2024-08-25 for the whole Annex, after a transition period; a site master file updated for sterile areas.
From 2023-08-25 for the whole Annex, lyophilisers included; a quality system manual for sterile products.
From 2023-08-25, with point 8.123 on lyophilisers from 2024-08-25; a contamination control strategy.
From 2022-08-25, its publication date, with immediate effect; a validation master plan for each aseptic line.
bank.expl:
- C: Annex 1(2022-08-25 공표)은 2023-08-25 시행이고, 8.123만 2024-08-25다. 핵심 신규 개념은 CCS다.
- A: 2024-08-25는 8.123에만 해당한다.
- B: 동결건조기 조항은 1년 늦게 시행됐다.
- D: 2022-08-25는 공표일이다.

bank.title: Annex 11 draft and a 2026 inspection
bank.stem: An EU inspector reviews a site's computerised systems in 2026, before the reference date of 2026-09-01. The IT team has rebuilt its validation around the July 2025 draft of Annex 11 and argues that the 2011 text no longer applies. Evaluate.
options: Incorrect — Annex 11 was folded into Chapter 4 in 2025, so Chapter 4 now governs alone.
Correct — Annex 22 on AI replaced Annex 11 when the consultation ended on 2025-10-07.
Incorrect — the 2025 draft was not final as of 2026-09-01, so the 2011 Annex 11 applies.
Correct — once a draft has closed its public consultation, inspectors apply it as the current text.
bank.expl:
- C: Ch.4·Annex 11 개정과 Annex 22(AI)는 2025-07-07 초안, 의견수렴 2025-10-07 종료, 2026-09-01 기준 최종본 미공표다. 사찰 기준은 2011년 판이고, 초안 방향(위험 기반 검증·audit trail·공급자 관리)은 준비에 참고한다.
- A: 통합된 적이 없다. 둘 다 개정 초안 단계다.
- B: Annex 22는 신설 초안이고 Annex 11을 대체하지 않는다.
- D: 의견수렴 종료가 채택을 뜻하지 않는다.

bank.title: autologous product in two regions
bank.stem: An autologous cell therapy is an ATMP in the EU and a 351 biologic in the US, made at one site. Which pairing of governing GMP texts is correct?
options: EU: Part I plus Annex 2, as for other biologicals; US: 21 CFR 1271 Subpart D cGTP on its own.
EU: Annex 1 as the standalone sterile text; US: 1271 Subpart D combined with ICH Q7 guidance.
EU: Part II, because the cells are treated as the active substance; US: 210/211 without cGTP.
EU: Part IV with an MIA and QP; US: 210/211, 1271 Subpart D and the 600s.
bank.expl:
- D: EU는 Part IV ATMP GMP(Reg 1394/2007 Art 5 근거)에 MIA·QP, US는 210/211 + 1271 Subpart D(cGTP) + 600s다.
- A: ATMP엔 Part I/Annex 2 대신 Part IV다. 351 제품은 cGTP만으로 부족하다.
- B: Annex 1 원칙은 준용일 뿐이고, Q7은 API 지침이다.
- C: Part II는 API 지침이고, cGTP가 빠졌다.

bank.title: traceability retention
bank.stem: For the same autologous product, the quality team sets record retention periods for traceability in its records tracker. Which pairing reflects the EU and US requirements?
options: EU 30 years under Regulation 1394/2007 Article 15; US 10 years under Part 1271.
EU 15 years under Annex 16; US 10 years under the general records rule 211.180.
EU 10 years under Part IV; US 30 years under the Part 1271 tracking rules.
EU and US both 30 years, a period harmonised for cell products through ICH Q10.
bank.expl:
- A: 추적성 기록은 EU Reg 1394/2007 Art 15 30년, 미국 1271 10년이다.
- B: Annex 16은 QP 인증 지침이고, 211.180은 일반 기록 조항이다.
- C: 두 숫자가 뒤바뀌었다.
- D: Q10은 PQS 모델이고 보존 기간을 조화하지 않는다.

bank.title: EV product and ATMP status
bank.stem: A team plans US and EU filings in the same quarter for an MSC-derived extracellular vesicle product made in a new aseptic suite. The EU project plan assumes Part IV ATMP GMP. Why should the plan be revisited first?
options: EVs are exempt from EU GMP until the MAA is approved, so inspection planning can wait until then.
EVs are ATMPs by definition, so the plan stands but must also add 1271 Subpart D cGTP for the EU filing.
EVs contain no cells, so ATMP status is not automatic; CAT classification should settle the GMP texts.
EVs fall under Part II as active substances, so the EU inspection will follow ICH Q7 instead.
bank.expl:
- C: EV는 세포를 포함하지 않아 ATMP 정의에 바로 들어가지 않고 생물의약품 쪽이 일반적이다. CAT 분류 권고로 먼저 확정해야 Part I 또는 Part IV, Annex 1 CCS 계획이 정해진다.
- A: EU 사찰은 CHMP 평가 중에 요청된다. 승인 뒤로 미룰 수 없다.
- B: 1271은 미국 규정이다.
- D: Part II는 API 지침이다.

bank.title: PAI data integrity objective
bank.stem: For the same product, the US pre-approval inspection is expected during BLA review. Which readiness item maps to the data integrity audit objective of CPGM 7346.832?
options: Completing Stage 2 process validation and an aseptic process simulation.
Matching the BLA quality section to the site's batch records and specifications.
A documented contamination control strategy under EU GMP Annex 1.
Raw data and audit trails for the potency, sterility and endotoxin tests.
bank.expl:
- D: 7346.832의 data integrity 감사는 역가·무균·엔도톡신 raw data와 audit trail을 본다.
- A: 상업 생산 준비도 항목이다.
- B: 신청서 일치 항목이다.
- C: EU Annex 1 요구다.

bank.title: CMO OAI and the sponsor's BLA
bank.stem: A start-up sponsor's BLA names a contract manufacturer that is classified OAI after an inspection for an unrelated product. The CEO says the problem belongs to the CMO. Which analysis should regulatory give to legal and management?
options: The OAI affects the CMO's own products, since 200.10(b) places responsibility on the facility alone.
The CEO is right; OAI attaches to the CMO's other product, and the BLA review continues on its own data.
The CMO's OAI can lead to a Complete Response for the BLA, so the sponsor must engage in remediation.
The BLA proceeds, but the sponsor must switch to an EU QP release model to avoid the OAI effect.
bank.expl:
- C: CMO가 OAI면 그 시설이 포함된 pending 신청은 승인 보류되고 BLA는 CR을 받는다. 200.10(b)로 owner와 CMO가 함께 책임진다(III-6 법적 책임).
- A: 200.10(b)는 owner와 CMO 모두에 책임을 둔다.
- B: OAI는 사이트 분류라 그 사이트를 쓰는 신청에 영향을 준다.
- D: QP 모델은 EU 출하 제도이고 FDA의 시설 판단을 바꾸지 않는다.

bank.title: Warning Letter and a pending ANDA
bank.stem: A US finished-dose site receives a Warning Letter for CGMP violations and is classified OAI. The same site is named in your pending ANDA. What is the most likely effect on the application?
options: The ANDA proceeds normally, because a Warning Letter concerns marketed products and does not affect pending applications.
The ANDA is approved with a postmarketing commitment requiring the site to complete its corrective actions within a set period.
Approval is withheld while the site remains OAI; the ANDA can stay under review but cannot be approved until the status is resolved.
The ANDA is refused to file, and the applicant must resubmit it once the Warning Letter has been formally closed out by FDA in writing.
bank.expl:
- C: OAI 사이트가 포함된 pending 신청은 **승인 보류**된다. 접수와 심사는 계속될 수 있지만 시설 미적합으로 승인되지 않는다(ANDA는 "facility inadequate" CR).
- A: WL은 공개 경고이면서 pending 신청의 승인 보류로 이어진다. 시판 제품에 한정된 효과가 아니다.
- B: 시설 OAI 상태를 시판 후 약속으로 대신해 승인하는 경로는 교과서에 없다.
- D: 신청이 접수 거부되는 것은 아니다. 심사는 진행되고 승인만 막힌다.

bank.title: what closes a Warning Letter
bank.stem: Under the policy FDA introduced in 2009, when is a Warning Letter close-out letter issued?
options: When two years pass without a new Form 483 at the site, at which point the letter is withdrawn from the FDA website.
When FDA has verified, usually through a follow-up inspection, that the violations cited in the letter have been corrected.
When an independent expert certifies CGMP compliance and the court supervising the firm approves the certification.
When the firm submits its written response within 15 working days and FDA finds the planned actions adequate on paper.
bank.expl:
- B: close-out letter(2009)는 FDA가 WL 항목의 **교정을 확인**했을 때 발행된다. 확인은 보통 follow-up 사찰로 하고, VAI/NAI 재분류 뒤 승인이 재개된다.
- A: 기간 경과로 자동 종결되는 규정은 없다.
- C: 독립 전문가 인증과 법원 승인은 consent decree의 재가동 조건이다.
- D: 기한 내 서면 응답은 출발점일 뿐이다. 계획만으로는 종결되지 않는다.

bank.title: Warning Letter response deadline
bank.stem: A Warning Letter dated Monday 3 August 2026 asks for a response within 15 working days. Counting from the day after the letter and assuming no federal holiday falls in the period, by when must the response arrive?
options: Friday 21 August 2026, counting 15 working days with the letter date itself included.
Tuesday 18 August 2026, counting 15 calendar days from the date of the letter.
Monday 24 August 2026, counting 15 working days from the date of the letter.
Thursday 3 September 2026, counting 30 calendar days from the date of the letter.
bank.expl:
- C: 다음 날(8월 4일, 화)부터 영업일을 센다. 8/4–8/7이 4일, 8/10–8/14가 9일, 8/17–8/21이 14일, 8/24(월)이 15번째다.
- A: 서한 날짜를 첫날로 넣어 하루 일찍 끝냈다. 다음 날부터 센다.
- B: 달력일 15일로 센 날짜다. WL 기한은 working days다.
- D: WL 응답 기한은 15 working days다. 30일 기준은 근거가 없다.

bank.title: Form 483 response window
bank.stem: An FDA investigator issues a Form 483 at the close-out meeting on Friday 6 March 2026. The firm wants its response to be considered before FDA decides whether to issue a Warning Letter. Assuming no holidays, what is the last day to submit?
options: Saturday 21 March 2026, because the window is 15 calendar days.
Monday 23 March 2026, because weekend deadlines roll to Monday.
Monday 6 April 2026, because the window is one calendar month.
Friday 27 March 2026, because the window is 15 business days.
bank.expl:
- D: 483 응답 창은 **15 business days**(2009 FR)다. 3/9–3/13이 5일, 3/16–3/20이 10일, 3/23–3/27이 15일이라 3월 27일(금)이 마지막 날이다.
- A: 달력일 15일로 센 날이다. business days와 calendar days를 혼동했다.
- B: 달력일로 센 뒤 주말을 넘긴 것이다. 기준 자체가 business days다.
- C: 한 달 기준은 근거가 없다.

bank.title: business days versus working days
bank.stem: Which statement about the US response windows for a Form 483 and a Warning Letter is correct?
options: Both are 15 days counted in business (working) days; the common error is counting them as calendar days.
The Form 483 window is 15 calendar days, while the Warning Letter window is 15 working days from the letter.
The Form 483 window is set by regulation in 21 CFR 211, while the Warning Letter window is set by the FD&C Act.
The Form 483 window is 15 business days, while the Warning Letter window is 15 calendar days from receipt.
bank.expl:
- A: 483은 **15 business days**, WL은 **15 working days**다. business days와 working days는 같은 뜻(영업일)이고, 함정은 달력일로 세는 것이다.
- B·D: 둘 중 하나를 달력일로 바꾼 오답이다. 둘 다 영업일 기준이다.
- C: 483 응답 창은 2009 FR 고지에서 나왔다. 211 조문이 아니다.

bank.title: why the 483 deadline matters
bank.stem: A firm plans to send a thorough Form 483 response well after the 483 response window, arguing that a more complete package will impress FDA. What is the main weakness of this plan?
options: FDA considers responses received within 15 business days before deciding on a Warning Letter; a late one may not be.
A late response converts the observations into a Warning Letter, because each 483 item carries a formal grade.
A late response voids the Form 483, so FDA must re-inspect the site before any classification can be made.
A late response is treated as a refusal of inspection under 501(j), which makes the products adulterated by itself under the Act.
bank.expl:
- A: 2009 FR 고지에 따라 **15 business days 안의 응답**은 WL 결정 전에 검토된다. 늦으면 WL 판단에 반영되지 않을 수 있으니, 기한 안에 내고 이후 **업데이트 응답**으로 보완한다.
- B: 개별 483 항목엔 공식 등급이 없고, 늦은 응답이 WL로 자동 전환되지도 않는다.
- C: 483은 관찰사항 목록이다. 응답이 늦어도 무효가 되지 않는다.
- D: 501(j)는 사찰 거부·지연·제한·방해다. 483 응답 지연과 다르다.

bank.title: CR letter citing a CMO's OAI status
bank.stem: Your pending BLA receives a Complete Response letter citing only the OAI status of your contract manufacturer. The product data are not questioned. Which statement about the two options is correct?
options: Fixing the CMO shifts legal responsibility for the CGMP failure to the CMO, so the applicant carries less risk from here.
Switching sites avoids any new inspection, because the product data already support approval of the BLA.
Fixing the CMO avoids comparability work, but the timing depends on the CMO's CAPA and an FDA re-inspection.
Switching sites requires just a Class 1 resubmission, since new site data are classified as minor information.
bank.expl:
- C: CMO 교정은 comparability가 필요 없지만, CMO의 CAPA → FDA **재사찰** → OAI 해소를 거쳐야 해서 일정을 통제할 수 없다.
- A: **200.10(b)**상 owner와 CMO가 함께 책임진다. 책임이 넘어가지 않는다.
- B: 새 제조소는 검증·**Q5E** comparability·안정성 데이터와 **새 PAI**가 필요하다.
- D: 새 제조소 데이터는 major amendment 또는 Class 2 + 새 PAI 대상이다.

bank.title: resubmission clock after a facility CR
bank.stem: After a facility-based CR, the CMO completes its CAPA and the sponsor resubmits on 2 March 2026. FDA must re-inspect the site to confirm the corrective actions. What is the review goal date?
options: 2 September 2026, because a Class 2 resubmission has a 6-month goal.
2 May 2026, because a Class 1 resubmission has a 2-month goal.
2 June 2026, because a resubmission after a CR is reviewed in 3 months.
2 July 2026, because a facility resubmission adds 2 months to a Class 1 goal.
bank.expl:
- A: 재사찰이 필요한 재제출은 **Class 2, 6개월**이다. 2026년 3월 2일 + 6개월 = 2026년 9월 2일.
- B: Class 1(2개월)은 재사찰이 필요 없는 경미한 재제출이다.
- C: 3개월은 major amendment의 목표일 연장이다. 재제출 기한이 아니다.
- D: 두 기한을 더하는 규정은 없다.

bank.title: major amendment for a new site
bank.stem: During review of a BLA with a PDUFA goal date of 15 October 2026, the sponsor submits data for a replacement manufacturing site, which FDA treats as a major amendment. What is the new goal date?
options: 15 October 2026, because amendments are reviewed in the next cycle, not this one.
15 April 2027, because new site data restart a 6-month review from the amendment.
15 January 2027, because a major amendment extends the goal date by 3 months.
15 December 2026, because a major amendment extends the goal date by 2 months.
bank.expl:
- C: major amendment는 PDUFA 목표일을 **3개월** 연장한다. 2026년 10월 15일 + 3개월 = 2027년 1월 15일.
- A: major amendment는 현 주기에서 심사되고 목표일이 늘어난다.
- B: 6개월은 Class 2 재제출 기한이다. major amendment는 심사를 처음부터 다시 시작시키지 않는다.
- D: 2개월은 Class 1 재제출 기한이다.

bank.title: Class 1 versus Class 2
bank.stem: Which pairing of resubmission class and review goal is correct for a response to a Complete Response letter?
options: Class 1: 2 months; Class 2: 6 months, including resubmissions needing a re-inspection.
Class 1: 3 months; Class 2: 6 months, with re-inspections handled outside the review clock.
Class 1: 2 months; Class 2: 10 months, matching the standard review period for an original.
Class 1: 6 months; Class 2: 2 months, reserved for resubmissions needing a re-inspection.
bank.expl:
- A: **Class 1 2개월, Class 2 6개월**이다. 재사찰이 필요하면 Class 2다.
- B: Class 1은 2개월이다. 3개월은 major amendment 연장이다.
- C: Class 2는 6개월이다.
- D: 두 숫자가 뒤바뀌었다.

bank.title: shipments under Import Alert 66-40
bank.stem: A Korean finished-dose plant is placed on Import Alert 66-40 after an OAI inspection. A shipment from the plant arrives at a US port the following week. What happens to it?
options: It is seized by US Marshals under section 304, and the importer must contest the seizure in federal district court.
It is detained without physical examination; the importer may present evidence, and failing that the entry is refused.
It is admitted if the importer posts a bond, because Import Alert 66-40 is limited to shipments of newly approved products.
It is released after a sample is tested by FDA and found to meet the specifications in the approved application.
bank.expl:
- B: **DWPE** — 입항 시 **자동 억류**되고, 수입자는 통지 후 반증 기회를 가진다. 반증 실패 시 **801(a) refusal**(반송·폐기).
- A: 304 seizure는 법원 절차를 밟는 별도 집행 수단이다. Import Alert의 기본 효과가 아니다.
- C: 보증금으로 입항시키는 예외는 교과서에 없다.
- D: 검사 없이 억류하는 것이 DWPE다. 시험 합격으로 해제되는 구조가 아니다.

bank.title: getting off Import Alert 66-40
bank.stem: The same Korean plant has completed its CAPA and wants to be removed from Import Alert 66-40. Which plan best matches FDA expectations?
options: Ask the importer of record to certify each shipment as compliant, which removes the plant from the alert after six months of clean entries.
Obtain an EU GMP certificate for the plant, which FDA accepts in place of its own inspection under the EU-US MRA.
Petition FDA with evidence of completed CAPA, a third-party audit and the affected-batch investigation, and expect a re-inspection.
Submit an updated Form 483 response, since removal follows once FDA accepts that response as adequate in writing.
bank.expl:
- C: 제거는 **petition**(CAPA 완료 증거·제3자 감사·영향 배치 조사) + **재사찰**(보통 필수)이다. 수개월~수년이 걸리고, 특정 제품 exclusion도 요청할 수 있다.
- A: 수입자 인증이나 기간 경과로 삭제되는 경로는 없다.
- B: MRA는 EU·미국 사찰 상호 인정이다. 한국 제조소의 Import Alert 제거 수단이 아니다.
- D: 483 응답 수용만으로 자동 삭제되지 않는다. 재사찰에서 VAI/NAI가 나와야 한다.

bank.title: legal basis for refusing entry
bank.stem: Under which provision is a drug shipment held under DWPE ultimately refused admission into the United States?
options: FD&C 302, because a court has enjoined the foreign manufacturer.
FD&C 801(a), because the product appears to be adulterated.
FD&C 501(j), because the importer delayed the FDA inspection.
FD&C 306, because the foreign firm has been debarred by FDA.
bank.expl:
- B: DWPE 억류 후 반증에 실패하면 **801(a)**에 따라 표면상 adulterated로 **refusal**된다.
- A: 302는 금지명령이다.
- C: 501(j)는 사찰 거부·지연을 adulteration으로 보는 조항이다. 입항 거부의 근거 조항이 아니다.
- D: 306은 debarment다.

bank.title: consent decree terms
bank.stem: Which set of terms is typical of an FDA consent decree of permanent injunction for repeated CGMP violations?
options: A one-time civil money penalty under the drug CGMP provisions, after which the firm returns to routine surveillance inspection.
A mandatory recall order for every marketed batch, issued by FDA under its drug recall authority without a court decision.
Shutdown of affected operations, restart only after independent expert certification and FDA approval, and liquidated damages.
Suspension of the firm's registration for one year, after which the court terminates the decree once a Form 483 is closed.
bank.expl:
- C: consent decree는 302 금지명령 소송의 합의로 법원이 명령한 것이다. 생산·유통 중단, **독립 전문가** 인증 후 FDA 승인 재가동, 수년 감사·보고, **일당·배치당 liquidated damages**, FDA 비용 상환, 임원 개인 명시가 전형이다.
- A: 의약품 CGMP 위반엔 일반 civil money penalty가 없다.
- B: 의약품에는 mandatory recall 권한이 없다.
- D: 5년 이상이 흔하고, 종료는 FDA 신청과 법원 결정으로 한다.

bank.title: where the consent decree sits
bank.stem: A board member asks why FDA would seek a consent decree rather than another Warning Letter for a firm with three Warning Letters in five years. Which explanation fits the enforcement ladder?
options: A consent decree replaces criminal prosecution under 303, so executives named in it cannot later be held personally liable for the same acts.
A consent decree is an administrative letter that carries more weight than a Warning Letter but has the same legal basis.
A consent decree puts compliance under a court order, so further violations carry court-ordered consequences such as damages.
A consent decree is required whenever a firm is classified OAI, so the number of earlier Warning Letters is not relevant.
bank.expl:
- C: WL은 행정 서한이다. 반복 위반·WL 무시 뒤엔 302 금지명령 소송의 합의로 **법원 명령**이 생기고, 위반하면 liquidated damages 같은 법원 명령상 결과가 따른다.
- A: consent decree는 303 형사책임을 없애지 않는다. Park doctrine은 그대로다.
- B: WL과 달리 consent decree는 법원 명령이다. 같은 법적 근거가 아니다.
- D: OAI는 규제 조치 권고일 뿐이다. 모든 OAI가 consent decree로 가지 않는다.

bank.title: CAP site with a non-compliance statement
bank.stem: A national inspection of a site making a centrally authorised product finds critical deficiencies, and the NCA issues a GMP non-compliance statement. Which EU-level step follows for the marketing authorisation itself?
options: The MAH must withdraw the authorisation within 90 days, because a non-compliance statement cancels any GMP certificate.
The supervisory NCA suspends the centralised marketing authorisation directly under Article 118 of Directive 2001/83.
EMA and the CHMP assess benefit-risk and supply need, and the Commission may act under Article 20 of Regulation 726/2004.
Each member state decides separately whether to keep the product on its market under its own national authorisation.
bank.expl:
- C: 비준수 선언은 EudraGMDP에 공개되고(111(7)), CAP이라 **EMA·CHMP**가 B/R·공급 필수성을 평가한 뒤 **Reg 726/2004 Art 20**으로 EC가 조치한다(MA 정지·제조소 삭제·회수). 긴급하면 **20(4)**로 회원국이 먼저 사용을 정지할 수 있다.
- A: 90일은 Art 111(5) 인증서 발행 기한이다. MAH 철회 의무 규정이 아니다.
- B: Art 118은 사찰국의 **MIA** 조치다. CAP의 MA 조치는 Art 20이다.
- D: CAP은 중앙 허가라 회원국별 국가 허가로 처리하지 않는다.

bank.title: supply-critical product after non-compliance
bank.stem: A critical-deficiency finding leads to a non-compliance statement for the only EU site making a medicine with no therapeutic alternative. Patients would be harmed by a sudden stop in supply. Which outcome does the EU system allow?
options: Supply continues unchanged until the next routine inspection, because a non-compliance statement has effect only on new batches.
Limited supply may continue under conditions such as added testing and reinforced QP oversight, while CAPA is completed.
The product must be recalled in full, because a critical deficiency rules out any further certification by a QP.
The MAH may move manufacturing to any PIC/S site without a variation, because supply need overrides the MA terms.
bank.expl:
- B: 공급 필수 제품은 **supply-critical** 경로로 추가 시험·QP 강화 같은 조건을 붙여 **제한 공급을 유지**할 수 있다(MSSG 관여). 재사찰·CAPA 뒤 statement가 철회되고 인증서가 재발급된다.
- A: 비준수 선언 뒤엔 MAH·QP가 영향 배치 회수·출하 중단을 판단한다. 아무 조치 없이 계속되지 않는다.
- C: 전면 회수만 있는 것은 아니다. 공급 필수성 평가가 조건부 유지를 허용한다.
- D: 제조소 변경은 variation 대상이다. 공급 필요가 MA 조건을 없애지 않는다.

bank.title: Articles 116, 117 and 118
bank.stem: Which mapping of Directive 2001/83 enforcement articles is correct?
options: Art 116 suspends the manufacturing authorisation; Art 117 suspends the MA; Art 118 recalls batches from the market.
Art 116 recalls batches; Art 117 revokes the MIA; Art 118 lets EMA suspend centralised authorisations directly.
Art 116 issues the GMP certificate; Art 117 issues the non-compliance statement; Art 118 publishes both in EudraGMDP.
Art 116 suspends or revokes the MA; Art 117 prohibits supply and recalls; Art 118 suspends the manufacturing authorisation.
bank.expl:
- D: **116** MA 정지·철회·변경, **117** 공급 금지·회수, **118** MIA 정지·철회다.
- A: 116과 118의 대상이 뒤바뀌었다.
- B: CAP 조치는 Reg 726/2004 Art 20이다. Art 118은 MIA 조치다.
- C: 인증서와 비준수 선언은 Art 111(5)·111(7)이다.

bank.title: unexpected excursion, specifications met
bank.stem: During batch certification a QP finds an unexpected excursion of a validated process parameter. All registered specifications are met. The investigation and a QRM assessment concluded there is no impact on quality. Under Annex 16, what may the QP do?
options: Certify the batch and treat the excursion as a planned change, so that future batches may run at the same setting.
Refuse certification, because any deviation from the validated process blocks certification until a variation is approved.
Certify the batch only after the NCA has approved the deviation, since QPs may not judge process excursions alone.
Certify the batch, provided the deviation is recorded and tracked in the PQS and extra testing is added where needed.
bank.expl:
- D: **Annex 16 §3**: **예상치 못한 편차**는 모든 등록 규격 충족, QRM 영향 평가(영향 없음), 등록·조사·기록, 필요시 추가 시험을 조건으로 QP가 인증을 고려할 수 있다.
- A: 앞으로 같은 조건으로 생산하려면 변경 관리·variation이 필요하다. 계획된 편차는 §3 대상이 아니다.
- B: §3이 바로 이런 편차에 인증 여지를 준다. variation 대상은 계획된 변경이다.
- C: §3은 NCA 사전 승인을 조건으로 두지 않는다.

bank.title: planned deviation
bank.stem: A production manager proposes to run the next three batches with a new mixing time not in the MA, arguing that the QP can certify them under Annex 16 section 3 if specifications are met. How should the QP respond?
options: Agree for up to three batches, after which section 3 requires the change to be filed as a Type IB variation.
Agree, because section 3 lets the QP certify a deviation once the batches meet each registered specification in the MA.
Decline, because section 3 applies just to deviations that the NCA finds during an inspection of the site.
Decline; section 3 covers unexpected deviations only, so a planned change goes through change control and a variation.
bank.expl:
- D: Annex 16 §3은 **예상치 못한 편차**에만 적용된다. **계획된 편차**는 변경 관리·variation으로 처리한다.
- A: 배치 수로 허용하는 규정은 없다.
- B: 규격 충족은 §3 조건의 하나일 뿐이고, 계획된 편차엔 §3 자체가 적용되지 않는다.
- C: §3은 회사가 발견한 예상치 못한 편차를 다룬다. NCA가 찾은 편차로 한정되지 않는다.

bank.title: which condition fails
bank.stem: A batch had an unexpected temperature excursion. The investigation found the root cause, the QRM assessment found no safety impact, and the deviation is logged in the PQS. However, one registered impurity limit was exceeded. Can the QP certify under Annex 16 section 3?
options: No, because section 3 requires every registered specification to be met, and one is exceeded here.
Yes, because the root cause is known and the QRM assessment found no safety impact on patients.
Yes, if additional stability testing is started and the results are reported to the NCA afterwards.
No, because a temperature excursion is a planned deviation and must go through a Type II variation.
bank.expl:
- A: §3의 첫 조건은 **모든 등록 규격 충족**이다. 불순물 한도를 넘었으면 다른 조건이 충족돼도 인증할 수 없다.
- B: 근본 원인과 위험 평가는 필요조건이지만 규격 충족을 대신하지 못한다.
- C: 추가 시험은 보완 조건이다. 규격 이탈을 덮지 못한다.
- D: 이 편차는 예상치 못한 것이다. 계획된 편차가 아니다.

bank.title: US counterpart to Annex 16 section 3
bank.stem: How does US CGMP handle the situation that EU Annex 16 section 3 addresses?
options: Through a QP-equivalent named in the NDA, who certifies batches with deviations under 21 CFR 211.22.
Through Annex 16 itself, which FDA applies to US sites by agreement under the EU-US MRA since 2019.
Through 211.192 investigation with quality unit approval and 211.100(b) justification; there is no QP.
Through prior FDA approval of each deviation in a CBE-30 supplement before the affected batch is released.
bank.expl:
- C: 미국은 **211.192** 조사·quality unit 승인과 **211.100(b)** 공정 편차 기록·정당화로 처리한다. **QP 조항은 없다**.
- A: 211.22는 조직으로서의 quality unit이다. 개인 QP가 아니다.
- B: MRA는 사찰 결과 인정이다. FDA가 Annex 16을 적용하지 않는다.
- D: 배치별 편차를 supplement로 사전 승인받는 구조는 교과서에 없다.

bank.title: Phase I OOS with an obvious error
bank.stem: A potency assay returns an OOS result. The analyst's Phase I checklist shows that the wrong dilution factor was entered in the calculation. Under FDA's OOS guidance, what is appropriate?
options: Average the OOS result with two retests, and release the batch if the mean meets the specification.
Open a full-scale Phase II investigation in production first, since laboratory error may not be assumed.
Resample the batch from the warehouse and report only the new sample, since the first was mishandled.
Invalidate the result as an assignable laboratory error, document the evidence, and repeat the analysis.
bank.expl:
- D: Phase I 실험실 조사에서 **명백한 실험 오류**(계산·희석·기기)가 확인되면 결과를 **invalidation**하고 근거를 문서화한다.
- A: 평균으로 OOS를 가리는 것은 금지다.
- B: 오류가 명백하면 Phase I에서 끝난다. 원인 없는 "lab error"가 금지일 뿐, 근거 있는 무효화는 허용된다.
- C: 재샘플링은 원 샘플의 비대표성이 입증될 때만이다. 이 경우는 계산 오류다.

bank.title: averaging OOS results
bank.stem: An assay result is OOS. Two retests under a predefined plan are within specification, and the lab proposes to report the mean of all three, which also passes. Which response reflects FDA's OOS guidance?
options: Not acceptable unless a fourth retest also passes, which then permits the mean to be reported.
Not acceptable; averaging must not be used to hide an OOS result, which needs a Phase II investigation.
Acceptable, because the mean is within specification and the retests followed a predefined plan.
Acceptable if the QP signs off, since the averaging rule applies to EU products under Chapter 6 rather than US ones.
bank.expl:
- B: **평균으로 OOS를 가리는 것은 금지**다. 명백한 실험 오류가 없으면 211.192 **Phase II 전면 조사**로 간다.
- A: 재시험을 더 해서 합격을 만드는 것이 testing into compliance다.
- C: 사전 계획된 재시험이어도 평균으로 OOS를 지우지 못한다.
- D: 미국 211.192와 FDA guidance 원칙이다. EU Ch.6 §6.35–6.37도 같은 원칙이다.

bank.title: resampling during an OOS investigation
bank.stem: During a Phase II OOS investigation the QC head wants to draw a fresh sample from the batch, because the retained sample has run low. Under FDA's OOS guidance, when is resampling acceptable?
options: When three retests of the original sample disagree, because the batch itself is then presumed to be variable.
Whenever the retained sample is insufficient, because a fresh sample gives a more current result for the batch.
Only after the QP has certified the batch, since resampling is a post-release confirmation step in the guidance.
When there is evidence that the original sample was not representative or was improperly prepared.
bank.expl:
- D: 재샘플링은 **원 샘플이 대표성이 없음**(또는 잘못 준비됨)이 입증될 때만 허용된다.
- A: 재시험 불일치는 조사 대상일 뿐, 재샘플링 근거가 아니다.
- B: 샘플 부족은 재샘플링 사유가 아니다. 새 샘플로 원 결과를 대체하면 testing into compliance가 된다.
- C: QP 인증은 EU 출하 절차다. FDA 재샘플링 규칙과 무관하다.

bank.title: OOS on a distributed batch
bank.stem: A stability OOS result is confirmed for an NDA product lot that is already on the market. The investigation is still open. What is the US reporting obligation?
options: File a Biological Product Deviation Report within 45 days, as for any distributed product.
Report within 15 calendar days as an expedited adverse event under the postmarketing rules.
File a Field Alert Report within 3 working days, even though the investigation is not finished.
Wait until the Phase II investigation closes, then report the root cause in the annual report.
bank.expl:
- C: 유통 배치의 규격 이탈은 **FAR 3 working days**(314.81(b)(1)(ii))다. 조사 완료 전이라도 보고한다.
- A: BPDR 45일(600.14)은 BLA 제품이다. NDA 제품은 FAR이다.
- B: 15-day 보고는 환자 유해 반응이 있을 때(314.80)다. 품질 결함 자체는 FAR이다.
- D: FAR은 조사 종결을 기다리지 않는다.

bank.title: counting the FAR window
bank.stem: On Thursday 9 April 2026 a firm learns that a distributed NDA lot failed its assay specification. Assuming no holidays, by when is the Field Alert Report due?
options: Sunday 12 April 2026, counting 3 calendar days.
Thursday 30 April 2026, counting 15 working days.
Monday 13 April 2026, counting 2 working days.
Tuesday 14 April 2026, counting 3 working days.
bank.expl:
- D: FAR은 **3 working days**다. 다음 날부터 4/10(금) 1일, 4/13(월) 2일, 4/14(화) 3일째다.
- A: 달력일로 센 날이다. FAR 기한은 working days다.
- B: 15 working days는 WL 응답 기한이다.
- C: 2일로 줄여 셌다. 기준은 3 working days다.

bank.title: common OOS citations
bank.stem: Which practice is most commonly cited by inspectors as a failure in OOS handling?
options: Defining the number of retests and the acceptance criteria before any retesting is performed.
Invalidating results as "lab error" without an identified cause and retesting until a pass is obtained.
Extending a confirmed OOS investigation to other batches and products made with the same process.
Running a Phase I laboratory checklist before deciding whether a full investigation is needed.
bank.expl:
- B: 원인 없이 "lab error"로 무효화하고 합격이 나올 때까지 시험하는 것(**testing into compliance**)이 흔한 지적이다. 조사 미완 출하도 그렇다.
- A: **사전 정의된 재시험 계획**은 guidance가 요구하는 것이다.
- C: 다른 배치·제품으로 확대하는 것은 Phase II의 요구사항이다.
- D: Phase I 체크리스트는 guidance가 요구하는 첫 단계다.

bank.title: FDA process validation stages
bank.stem: Which sequence matches FDA's 2011 process validation guidance?
options: Installation qualification, operational qualification, performance qualification, then revalidation.
Process design, three conformance batches, then ongoing process verification under Annex 15.
Prospective validation, concurrent validation, retrospective validation, then annual review.
Process design, process qualification including PPQ, then continued process verification.
bank.expl:
- D: Stage 1 **Process Design** → Stage 2 **Process Qualification**(시설·장비 적격성 + **PPQ**) → Stage 3 **Continued Process Verification**이다. 규정 근거는 211.100(a)·211.110이다.
- A: 장비 적격성 단계명이다. 수명주기 3단계가 아니다.
- B: "3배치"는 guidance가 정한 수가 아니고, ongoing process verification은 Annex 15 용어다.
- C: 2011 guidance의 수명주기 구조가 아니다.

bank.title: how many PPQ batches
bank.stem: A CMO insists that three consecutive successful PPQ batches are required by FDA before commercial launch of your product. How should you respond?
options: Disagree; PPQ batches are optional once Stage 1 design data cover the commercial scale.
Agree, since the 2011 guidance fixes three PPQ batches as the minimum for any commercial process.
Agree for small molecules, but biologics require five batches under the guidance's product categories.
Disagree; the guidance sets no fixed number, and the batch count is justified by statistics and risk.
bank.expl:
- D: 2011 guidance는 PPQ 배치 수를 "3"으로 정하지 않는다. 통계·위험으로 정당화한다.
- A: PPQ는 Stage 2의 필수 요소다. 설계 데이터가 대신하지 못한다.
- B: "3배치"는 guidance의 요건이 아니다.
- C: 제품군별 배치 수 규정은 없다.

bank.title: Annex 15 features
bank.stem: Which feature belongs to EU GMP Annex 15 (2015) rather than to FDA's 2011 process validation guidance?
options: A choice of traditional, continuous or hybrid validation, with ongoing process verification.
Continued process verification as the formal name of the commercial monitoring stage.
Process qualification as Stage 2, combining facility qualification and PPQ batches.
A requirement that process validation be supported by 211.100(a) and 211.110 controls.
bank.expl:
- A: **Annex 15**(2015-10-01)는 **traditional / continuous / hybrid** 접근과 **ongoing process verification**을 둔다. concurrent validation 예외, 운송·포장·세척·유틸리티 검증, VMP도 다룬다.
- B·C: FDA 2011 guidance의 용어다.
- D: 211 조문은 미국 규정이다.

bank.title: drafting a quality agreement
bank.stem: You are drafting a quality agreement with an EU-based CMO that will also supply the US. Which clause set best meets both FDA's 2016 guidance and EU GMP Chapter 7?
options: A responsibilities matrix, change notification, deviation and complaint notice, audit access, subcontracting control and QP support.
A requirement that the CMO hold an EU GMP certificate, which transfers responsibility for GMP compliance to the CMO.
Price, volume forecasts, payment terms and liability caps, with quality duties covered by reference to the CMO's own SOPs and policies.
A list of the CMO's own quality metrics, with the owner's audit rights limited to cases where FDA issues a Form 483.
bank.expl:
- A: 역할·책임 분담표, **변경 통지**, 편차·OOS·불만·리콜 통보 시한, **감사·사찰 접근권**과 당국 결과 통지, 하도급 금지/승인, 기록·DI, 배치 기록·CoA와 **QP 인증 근거**가 핵심이다.
- B: 인증서가 있어도 **200.10(b)**·Ch.7상 owner 책임은 넘어가지 않는다.
- C: quality agreement는 사업 계약과 분리한다. 가격·물량은 사업 계약 내용이다.
- D: 감사 접근권을 483 발행 때로 한정하면 owner가 적격성을 보증할 수 없다.

bank.title: quality agreement versus supply contract
bank.stem: Your procurement team wants to fold the quality agreement into the master supply agreement to save time, and to let the CMO's quality unit hold final release responsibility. Which response reflects FDA's 2016 guidance and EU Chapter 7?
options: Keep it separate, but give final responsibility to the CMO because it holds the manufacturing authorisation.
Accept both changes, because a single contract is clearer and the CMO performs the release testing itself.
Keep the quality agreement separate from the business contract and keep final responsibility with the owner.
Accept the merger, but require that the CMO's quality unit be named in the NDA as the legally responsible party.
bank.expl:
- C: quality agreement는 **사업 계약과 분리**하고, 의약품 **owner가 최종 책임**을 진다(200.10(b)).
- A: MIA 보유와 무관하게 Ch.7상 contract giver가 acceptor의 적격성·GMP를 보증한다.
- B: 하나로 합치면 품질 의무가 상업 조건에 섞인다. CMO가 시험해도 최종 책임은 owner에게 남는다.
- D: CMO를 신청서에 책임 주체로 적어도 owner 책임은 그대로다.

bank.title: why the owner stays responsible
bank.stem: A biotech outsources all manufacturing and argues that a CMO's CGMP violations are the CMO's problem alone. Which statement best explains why both US and EU frameworks reject this view?
options: Because the CMO cannot be inspected by FDA unless the owner is present, so violations are attributed to the owner.
Because a CMO's Warning Letter is issued to the owner instead of the CMO, which is then shielded from enforcement.
Because EU law makes the CMO's QP personally liable for the owner's products, and US law copies this approach for contract sites.
Because outsourcing would otherwise leave a regulatory gap; 200.10(b) treats the CMO as an extension of the owner's facility.
bank.expl:
- D: 외주로 책임을 넘기면 규제 공백이 생긴다. **200.10(b)**는 CMO를 owner 시설의 연장으로 보고 **owner와 CMO 모두**에 책임을 지운다. EU Ch.7도 contract giver가 acceptor를 평가·보증한다.
- A: FDA는 CMO를 직접 사찰한다. owner 입회는 조건이 아니다.
- B: CMO WL은 CMO에 발행되고 owner 제품명과 함께 공개된다. CMO가 면제되지 않는다.
- C: 미국에는 QP가 없다.

bank.title: no audit record of the CMO
bank.stem: During an EU inspection of a MAH's release site, the inspector asks for the audit report on the third-country CMO that makes the bulk. The MAH has none and relies on the CMO's own statements of compliance. How is this likely to be viewed?
options: As acceptable, because the CMO holds its own national licence and is responsible for its own GMP compliance.
As a matter for the CMO's national authority only, since EU inspectors may not review third-country suppliers.
As a deficiency of the MAH and its QP, who must have a documented basis to rely on the CMO's GMP status.
As acceptable if the CMO has been inspected by any PIC/S member, which replaces audits by the contract giver.
bank.expl:
- C: Ch.7상 contract giver가 acceptor의 적격성·GMP를 평가·보증하고, QP는 **Annex 16 §1.7**로 공급망 신뢰 근거를 가져야 한다. **감사 기록 부재 = owner 결함**이다.
- A: CMO 자체 허가가 있어도 contract giver의 평가 의무는 남는다.
- B: EU 사찰관은 MAH·QP가 외부 사이트를 믿는 근거를 본다.
- D: 다른 당국 사찰 결과는 참고 근거일 뿐이다. contract giver의 평가 의무를 없애지 않는다.

bank.title: items specific to the EU PQR
bank.stem: Which item is listed in the EU Product Quality Review (Chapter 1 section 1.10) but is not part of the short US annual review list in 211.180(e)?
options: Evaluation of the need to change specifications or manufacturing methods.
Review of a representative number of batch records for the product.
Review of complaints, recalls and returned goods for the product.
Status of MA variations submitted, granted or refused during the period.
bank.expl:
- D: **PQR 12항목**에는 **MA variation 제출·승인·거부 현황**, quality agreement 최신성, 장비·유틸리티 적격성 같은 항목이 있다. 211.180(e)엔 이런 열거가 없다.
- A·B·C: 211.180(e)가 요구하는 내용이다(대표 배치, 불만·리콜·반품, 규격·공정 변경 필요성).

bank.title: building one global annual review
bank.stem: A company wants a single annual review template that satisfies both 211.180(e) and EU Chapter 1 section 1.10. Which approach works?
options: Use the 211.180(e) list and add only the stability trend, which is the one item the EU adds to the US list.
Use the 12 PQR items, which cover the 211.180(e) elements, and keep the evaluation of needed changes.
Use the 211.180(e) list, since the EU accepts the US format under the EU-US MRA for products made in the US.
Use the 12 PQR items but drop the batch record review, since 211.180(e) leaves that to the quality unit.
bank.expl:
- B: PQR **12항목**은 211.180(e) 요소(대표 배치·불만·리콜·반품·조사, 변경 필요성)를 포함하고 더 넓다. 그래서 PQR 기준 양식에 변경 필요성 판단을 유지하면 양쪽을 충족한다.
- A: EU는 variation 현황, quality agreement 최신성 등 여러 항목을 더 요구한다.
- C: MRA는 사찰 결과 인정이다. PQR 요건을 면제하지 않는다.
- D: 대표 배치 기록 검토는 211.180(e) 요건이다. 빼면 미국을 충족하지 못한다.

bank.title: particles in an NDA injectable
bank.stem: A hospital reports visible particles in a vial of your NDA injectable. Other vials from the same lot are still in distribution, and the root cause is not yet known. Which US action set is correct?
options: Notify FDA if a patient was harmed; a quality defect without injury goes into the annual report instead.
File a BPDR within 45 days, then decide on a recall once the retained samples have been compared with the vial.
Record and investigate the complaint, assess the risk, and file a FAR within 3 working days without waiting for the outcome.
Record the complaint and wait for the investigation to finish, then file a FAR within 3 working days of its formal conclusion.
bank.expl:
- C: 211.198 접수·기록, 211.192 조사, 위험 평가를 진행하면서 **FAR 3 working days**(314.81(b)(1)(ii))를 **조사 완료 전이라도** 낸다.
- A: 품질 결함 자체가 FAR 대상이다. 환자 유해는 314.80 15-day 보고가 따로 붙는다.
- B: BPDR(600.14)은 BLA 제품이다.
- D: FAR 기한은 조사 종결이 기준이 아니다.

bank.title: the same defect in a BLA product
bank.stem: The same particle complaint concerns a licensed biologic marketed under a BLA. Which US report applies to the manufacturing deviation affecting distributed product?
options: A 15-day expedited report under 314.80, even without patient harm.
A Field Alert Report within 3 working days under 314.81.
An annual report entry under 211.180(e) instead of a separate report.
A Biological Product Deviation Report within 45 days under 600.14.
bank.expl:
- D: BLA 제품은 **BPDR 45일**(600.14)이다.
- A: 15-day 보고는 환자 유해 반응이 있을 때다.
- B: FAR은 NDA/ANDA 제품이다.
- C: 유통 제품 영향 편차는 별도 보고 대상이다.

bank.title: EU quality defect notification
bank.stem: The particle defect also affects a centrally authorised product in the EU. The MAH judges that it could lead to a recall. Under EU GMP Chapter 8, what notification is required?
options: Notify EMA within 45 days through a deviation report, as for biologics under the US system.
Notify the competent authority and EMA without delay, involve the QP, and classify the defect.
Notify the authorities once the investigation has confirmed the root cause and the CAPA plan.
Notify the supervisory NCA within 3 working days, which then informs EMA if it agrees.
bank.expl:
- B: Ch.8 **§8.15** — 리콜이나 비정상 공급 제한으로 이어질 수 있는 결함은 **지체 없이** NCA(CAP은 **EMA**도)에 알린다. QP가 관여하고 결함 등급(Class I–III)을 평가한다.
- A: 45일은 미국 BPDR이다.
- C: Ch.8은 조사 종결을 기다리지 않는다.
- D: 3 working days는 미국 FAR이다. EU 기준은 "지체 없이"다.

bank.title: FDA asks for internal audit reports
bank.stem: An FDA investigator asks to read your internal audit reports from the past two years. There is no court order, criminal case or consent decree. How can the firm respond under FDA policy?
options: It must hand over the reports, because 211 makes internal audits mandatory and open to inspection by FDA staff.
It may cite CPG 130.300 and decline the report text, while showing the schedule, procedure and CAPA closure.
It may refuse to discuss the audit programme, because 501(j) protects audit programmes from FDA review.
It must provide the reports in redacted form within 15 business days, as with a Form 483 response.
bank.expl:
- B: **CPG 130.300**(1996)상 FDA는 **내부 감사 보고서를 일상적으로 요구하지 않는다**. 감사 수행 증거(일정·절차·CAPA 종결)는 요구할 수 있어 그것을 보여준다.
- A: 211엔 자체 감사 명문 요건이 없다.
- C: 501(j)는 사찰 거부를 adulteration으로 보는 조항이다. 오히려 협조 거부가 위험하다.
- D: 15 business days는 483 응답 창이다.

bank.title: EU self-inspection
bank.stem: Which statement about self-inspection in EU GMP is correct?
options: Chapter 9 makes self-inspection voluntary, and inspectors may review its reports when a court has ordered their disclosure.
Self-inspection is covered by Annex 16, because the QP must personally audit each site before certifying any batch.
Self-inspection follows CPG 130.300, which the EU adopted through PIC/S when FDA joined the scheme in 2011.
Chapter 9 makes self-inspection an explicit requirement: independent, regular and planned, with records and CAPA follow-up.
bank.expl:
- D: **Ch.9 Self Inspection**은 명시 요건이다. 독립적·정기적·사전 계획, **기록·CAPA·추적**이 필요하고 사찰관이 프로그램·기록·결과 조치를 본다.
- A: EU는 자발이 아니라 명시 요건이다. 법원 명령 예외는 미국 CPG 130.300 이야기다.
- B: Annex 16은 QP 인증이다. 자체 감사는 Ch.9다.
- C: CPG 130.300은 FDA 정책이다. EU 요건이 아니다.

bank.title: US site classification versus EU grading
bank.stem: A global QA head asks how a US Form 483 observation would be "graded" compared with an EU major deficiency. Which explanation is accurate?
options: Each 483 observation is graded NAI, VAI or OAI, and the most serious observation sets the outcome of the inspection.
Individual 483 observations carry no formal grade; FDA classifies the whole site as NAI, VAI or OAI.
FDA grades only data integrity observations, while EU inspectors grade only critical deficiencies in their reports.
Each 483 observation is graded critical, major or other, as in the EU, and the grades then add up to the site status.
bank.expl:
- B: 미국은 개별 483 관찰에 **공식 등급이 없다**. 사이트 전체를 **NAI/VAI/OAI**로 분류한다. EU는 CoCP 양식에 따라 결함마다 **critical/major/other**를 매긴다.
- A: NAI/VAI/OAI는 사이트 분류다. 개별 관찰의 등급이 아니다.
- C: EU는 모든 결함을 세 등급으로 나누고, 미국은 관찰을 등급화하지 않는다.
- D: critical/major/other는 EU 결함별 등급이다.

bank.title: several major deficiencies
bank.stem: An EU inspection report lists no critical deficiency but five related major deficiencies in the quality system. The firm expects a GMP certificate. Which outcome is possible under the EU grading approach?
options: The majors are graded together as a critical deficiency, which can lead to a non-compliance statement.
The majors are downgraded to "other" once the firm commits to CAPA within the inspection period.
The majors are converted into a US-style OAI classification and forwarded to FDA under the MRA.
A certificate is issued in any case, because a single critical finding is needed to block certification of a site.
bank.expl:
- A: CoCP 등급에서 **다수의 major는 critical로 상승**할 수 있고, critical은 non-compliance statement로 이어질 수 있다.
- B: CAPA 약속으로 등급이 내려가는 규정은 없다.
- C: EU는 OAI 분류를 쓰지 않는다.
- D: 개별 critical이 없어도 major 누적으로 critical이 될 수 있다.

bank.title: data integrity remediation after a Warning Letter
bank.stem: A Warning Letter cites deleted chromatography injections and shared user accounts. Which remediation plan matches what FDA typically expects?
options: Disabling the audit trail during routine work to limit the volume of data that analysts must review each week.
Retraining of the analysts involved and a revised SOP for the affected instrument, without extending the review to other systems or sites.
Re-testing of the affected batches in another laboratory and submission of the passing results in reply to the letter.
A wide investigation with interviews, an impact risk assessment, and a management strategy including a third-party audit.
bank.expl:
- D: WL 표준 remediation은 ① 범위·원인 **종합 조사**(전 시스템·기간·현/전 직원 인터뷰, 제3자) ② 제품·데이터 신뢰성 **위험 평가** ③ **경영 전략**(글로벌 CAPA, 개인 계정·권한 분리·audit trail, **독립 제3자 감사**)이다.
- A: audit trail은 활성 상태로 주기 검토해야 한다.
- B: 해당 분석자·장비에 한정하면 시스템 전체 확장이 빠진다.
- C: 재시험 합격 결과만으로는 데이터 삭제의 원인과 범위를 다루지 못한다.

bank.title: integrity issue touching a pending application
bank.stem: The data integrity investigation shows that some deleted injections came from stability testing cited in a pending NDA. What should the sponsor do with the application?
options: Wait for the pre-approval inspection, where FDA will decide which stability data remain usable.
Withdraw the NDA, because any data integrity finding triggers debarment of the applicant under 306.
Disclose proactively to FDA, assess the data's reliability and resubmit or reanalyse affected data.
Leave the NDA unchanged, because data integrity findings at a site affect marketed products rather than applications.
bank.expl:
- C: 신청 데이터 신뢰성 영향까지 위험 평가에 넣고, 영향 데이터는 **선제 공개·재분석**하고 필요하면 재제출한다. 숨기면 **AIP**(1991)로 심사 전체가 보류될 수 있다.
- A: PAI는 data integrity 감사가 목표의 하나다. 기다리면 발견되어 AIP 위험이 커진다.
- B: debarment(306)는 GDEA 1992에 따른 별도 제재다. DI 지적이 자동으로 이어지지 않는다.
- D: 위험 평가는 신청 데이터 신뢰성을 포함한다.

bank.title: orders for a 361 HCT/P establishment
bank.stem: Under 21 CFR 1271.440, which orders may FDA issue to a 361 HCT/P establishment?
options: Retention, recall, destruction and cessation of manufacturing.
Seizure, injunction, consent decree and civil money penalty.
Warning Letter, Import Alert, FAR request and re-inspection.
Licence suspension, licence revocation, recall and debarment.
bank.expl:
- A: **1271.440**은 **retention·recall·destruction·cessation of manufacturing** 명령이다. 근거는 PHS 361이고 전염병 전파 위험 시 발령한다.
- B: 법원 절차 수단이고, 의약품 CGMP엔 일반 civil money penalty가 없다.
- C: 1271.440의 명령 목록이 아니다.
- D: license 정지·철회는 351 제품의 BLA 집행이다.

bank.title: 351 HCT/P enforcement layers
bank.stem: An HCT/P regulated as a 351 biologic under a BLA has cGTP violations. Compared with a 361 HCT/P, which additional enforcement tools apply?
options: BLA enforcement such as licence suspension or revocation, 211 CGMP, and a 351(d) recall order.
Import Alert 66-40 alone, since 351 products are assumed to be manufactured outside the US.
Nothing extra; 351 and 361 HCT/Ps share the same Subpart F orders, and the BLA adds nothing to enforcement.
A civil money penalty under 303(f)(1), which applies to each biologic that holds a licence.
bank.expl:
- A: 351 제품엔 Subpart F에 더해 **BLA 집행**(601.5/601.6 license 정지·철회), **211**, **351(d)** 회수 명령이 붙는다.
- B: Import Alert는 해외 제조품의 입항 억류 수단이다. 351 제품을 해외 제조로 가정하는 규정은 없다.
- C: 351 제품은 BLA 집행이 추가된다.
- D: 303(f)(1)은 의료기기 civil money penalty다.

bank.title: tools FDA lacks for drug CGMP
bank.stem: Which enforcement tool exists for medical devices but is not available to FDA for drug CGMP violations in general?
options: Seizure of violative products under section 304.
A civil money penalty as provided for devices in 303(f)(1).
Injunction and consent decree under section 302.
Criminal prosecution of responsible officers under section 303.
bank.expl:
- B: 의약품 CGMP 위반엔 일반 **civil money penalty**가 없다. 기기는 **303(f)(1)**에 있다.
- A·C·D: 304 압류, 302 금지명령·consent decree, 303 형사(Park doctrine)는 의약품에도 쓰는 수단이다.

bank.title: drug recall without a recall order
bank.stem: FDA concludes that a marketed small-molecule drug lot made under CGMP violations should leave the market, but the firm hesitates to recall. Which describes FDA's position?
options: FDA orders destruction of the lot under 1271.440, which applies to any product made under CGMP violations.
There is no drug mandatory recall; FDA relies on pressure such as seizure, injunction and publicity.
FDA issues a mandatory recall order under its drug authority, as it can for licensed biologics under 351(d).
FDA imposes a civil money penalty each day until the recall starts, which forces a so-called voluntary recall.
bank.expl:
- B: 의약품엔 **mandatory recall이 없어** 리콜은 '자발'이다. FDA는 압류·금지명령·공개로 압력을 넣는다.
- A: 1271.440은 HCT/P 명령이다.
- C: 351(d) 회수 명령은 생물의약품이다. 소분자 의약품엔 없다.
- D: 의약품 CGMP엔 일반 civil money penalty가 없다.

bank.title: AIP and debarment
bank.stem: Which pairing for two FDA integrity tools, the Application Integrity Policy (AIP) and debarment, is correct?
options: AIP applies to devices alone; debarment is limited to foreign drug manufacturers and their agents.
AIP (1992) bars individuals from the industry; debarment (306, 1991) suspends review of pending applications.
AIP (1991) suspends review when data reliability is in doubt; debarment (306, GDEA 1992) bars firms or individuals.
AIP is a court order obtained under 302, while debarment is an administrative category of Warning Letter used by FDA.
bank.expl:
- C: **AIP**(1991)는 데이터 신뢰성이 의심될 때 심사를 보류한다. **debarment**(306, **GDEA 1992**)는 ANDA 사기 등에 관여한 개인·회사를 배제한다.
- A: AIP는 의약품 신청 데이터에 쓰인다. debarment도 해외 제조소 한정이 아니다.
- B: 두 도구의 내용과 연도가 뒤바뀌었다.
- D: AIP는 법원 명령이 아니고, debarment는 WL 분류가 아니다.

bank.title: expiring EU GMP certificate
bank.stem: A third-country API site's EU GMP certificate in EudraGMDP expires next month, and the NCA has not scheduled a re-inspection. Which action plan is appropriate for the importer's QP?
options: Ask for re-inspection or a desk-based assessment and support reliance with MAH or QP audit reports meanwhile.
Continue as before without further action, because certificates remain valid until a new inspection is carried out.
Stop certifying batches from the expiry date, because an expired certificate equals a non-compliance statement.
Move to a US supplier at once without a variation, because the EU-US MRA treats FDA sites as already registered.
bank.expl:
- A: 만료가 비준수 선언은 아니지만 QP는 **Annex 16 §1.7** 근거가 필요하다. 사찰국에 **재사찰·desk-based 평가**를 요청하고, 그동안 **MAH/QP 감사 보고서**로 보강하며 Art 51 수입 시험, 46b 유효성, 대체 공급자 variation을 검토한다.
- B: QP는 신뢰 근거를 갖춰야 해서 아무 조치 없이 넘어갈 수 없다.
- C: 만료는 비준수 선언과 다르다.
- D: 제조소 변경은 variation 대상이다.

bank.title: GMP certificate timing and validity
bank.stem: Under Article 111(5) of Directive 2001/83, which statement about the EU GMP certificate is correct?
options: It is issued within 6 months of the inspection and is valid for 5 years, matching the MA renewal.
It is issued within 90 days of the inspection and usually shows a validity of 3 years.
It is issued within 15 working days of the inspection and is valid until the next variation.
It is issued within 90 days but only for EU sites; third-country sites receive a written confirmation.
bank.expl:
- B: Art 111(5)상 사찰 뒤 **90일 내** 인증서를 발행하고, 통상 **3년** 유효로 표기한다. 결과는 EudraGMDP에 공개된다.
- A: 90일·3년이 교과서 값이다.
- C: 15 working days는 미국 WL 응답 기한이다.
- D: 제3국 사이트도 EU NCA 사찰 뒤 인증서를 받는다. written confirmation(46b)은 수출국 당국의 API 문서다.

bank.title: OAI without a failed batch
bank.stem: A site has never released a batch that failed specification, yet FDA classifies it OAI and treats its products as adulterated. Which explanation is correct?
options: Under 501(a)(2)(B), methods, facilities and controls that do not conform to CGMP make the drug adulterated.
Under 501(j), any CGMP gap is treated as a refusal of inspection, which by itself makes the product adulterated.
OAI status requires proof of a defective batch somewhere in the market, which FDA may infer from complaints.
FDA presumes failure from the number of 483 observations, so passing results do not count once a threshold is passed.
bank.expl:
- A: **501(a)(2)(B)**는 결과가 아니라 **방법·시설·관리**의 CGMP 부합으로 adulteration을 정의한다(1962 이후 예방 기준). 시험은 샘플링이라 결함을 다 잡지 못하기 때문이다. 그래서 시스템을 고쳐야 한다.
- B: 501(j)는 사찰 거부·지연·제한이다.
- C: 실제 결함 증명은 필요 없다.
- D: 483 관찰 수로 결함을 추정하는 기준은 없다.

bank.title: executive liability
bank.stem: After repeated CGMP violations, prosecutors charge the company's president, who did not know of the specific violations but had authority to prevent them. Which doctrine supports the charge?
options: The Park doctrine under 303(a), which can hold responsible officers liable without proof of intent.
