bank.stem: A device maker replaces a component in the field to improve battery life. There is no health risk and no violation. What does Part 806 require?
options: A report within 10 working days, since any field replacement is a correction.
No report is required, but a record of the action must be kept under 806.20.
A Part 7 recall notice, since the replacement takes place at user level.
A report within 10 working days if more than one lot is affected.
bank.expl:
- B: 위험 감소가 아닌 성능·품질 개선은 **806.1(b) 예외**다. 보고하지 않더라도 **806.20 기록**을 남긴다.
- A: 모든 현장 교체가 보고 대상은 아니다. 목적이 위험 감소일 때다.
- C: 위법이 아니면 Part 7 리콜이 아니다.
- D: 로트 수는 806 보고 기준이 아니다.

bank.title: combination product, two systems
bank.stem: A BLA autoinjector has a needle-shield defect, and the firm corrects the device constituent in the field to reduce risk. Which reporting picture is correct in the US?
options: A FAR within 3 working days, which covers the whole event because the product is drug-led.
Part 806, which covers the event because the defect sits in the device constituent.
Part 806 for the device correction, plus Part 7 and a BPDR on the biologic side of the product.
Part 7 and a BPDR, with the device correction covered by the lead center's drug rules.
bank.expl:
- C: 기기 구성품 교정·제거는 **806(10 working days)** 이 적용되고(Part 4 Subpart B 틀), 의약품 쪽은 **Part 7·BPDR(BLA)** 이다. 한 사건을 **두 보고 체계**로 보낸다.
- A: FAR은 NDA/ANDA 보고다. 이 제품은 BLA이고, 기기 구성품 806도 빠졌다.
- B: 806은 기기 구성품만 다룬다. 생물의약품 쪽 Part 7·BPDR이 빠졌다.
- D: 기기 구성품 교정은 주관 센터의 의약품 규정으로 흡수되지 않는다. 806 보고가 따로 간다.

bank.title: cross-labeled information sharing
bank.stem: A drug and a separately marketed device are cross-labeled for use together, held by two different applicants. The drug applicant receives a complaint involving the device constituent. Under 21 CFR Part 4, when must it share the information with the device applicant?
options: Within 5 calendar days of receiving the information, under the Part 4 sharing rule.
Within 10 working days, the same period that applies to device corrections and removals.
Within 45 calendar days, aligned with the deviation reporting clock for biologics.
Within 3 working days, aligned with the field alert reporting clock for drugs.
bank.expl:
- A: 21 CFR Part 4의 콤비네이션 제품 정보 공유는 다른 구성품 신청자에게 **5 calendar days** 안이다.
- B: 10 working days는 806 보고다.
- C: 45일은 BPDR이다.
- D: 3 working days는 FAR이다.

bank.title: DCP notification targets
bank.stem: A product authorised through the decentralised procedure in five member states has a Class II defect. Batches were released in one member state, which is not the RMS. Whom must the MAH notify without delay?
options: EMA, since a multi-country product needs a single EU-level contact point for defects.
The supervisory authority, the RMS, and the NCA of the country where it was found.
The RMS, since it holds the marketing authorisation assessment for the five countries.
Each of the five CMS NCAs, since the defect concerns national authorisations.
bank.expl:
- B: DCP 제품은 MAH가 **지체 없이** ① **supervisory authority**(배치 출하·제조소 NCA, 결함 조사 주도) ② **RMS**(variation·Art 116 평가) ③ **발견국 NCA**에 통지한다. Art 123(2) 조치 통지도 한다.
- A: EMA 통지는 CAP 경로다. DCP 제품의 결함 조사는 supervisory authority가 주도한다.
- C: RMS는 MA 평가 담당이다. 결함 조사를 주도하는 supervisory authority와 발견국 NCA가 빠진다.
- D: supervisory authority와 RMS가 빠졌다.

bank.title: who sends the Class II alert
bank.stem: In the same DCP case, who issues the Rapid Alert, and within what time?
options: The supervisory authority, at the same time as national action, to the five member states.
The RMS, within 24 hours, to the five member states where the product is authorised.
The MAH, at once, to each NCA and to EMA using the Rapid Alert notification template.
The supervisory authority, within 24 hours, to all recipients wherever the batch went.
bank.expl:
- D: 발신은 **supervisory authority**이고, Class II는 **24시간 내** **전 수신처**(수출 여부 무관)다.
- A: "국가 조치와 동시"는 Class I 시한이고, 수신처도 다섯 나라로 좁히지 않는다.
- B: RMS는 발신 주체가 아니고, 수신처도 다섯 나라로 한정되지 않는다.
- C: MAH는 Rapid Alert 발신 주체가 아니다.

bank.title: Class I alert timing
bank.stem: Under the EU Rapid Alert procedure, how is a Class I quality defect transmitted?
options: Within 24 hours, to member states that received the batch and to EMA.
Within 48 hours, to the full recipient list, after the supervisory authority has confirmed the root cause.
At the same time as national action, to all recipients whether or not the batch was exported.
At the same time as national action, to the member states that received the batch.
bank.expl:
- C: Class I(잠재적 생명 위협·중대 위험)은 **국가 조치와 동시**에, 배치 수출 여부와 무관하게 **전 수신처**(EU/EEA NCA·EMA·EC·PIC/S·MRA·WHO)로 전파한다.
- A: 24시간은 Class II 시한이고, 수신처도 좁다.
- B: 48시간과 근본 원인 확인 조건은 근거가 없다.
- D: 수신처가 수출국으로 한정되지 않는다.

bank.title: Class III defect in the EU
bank.stem: A printing error with no safety impact leads an EU MAH to recall one batch, classed as Class III. The QA lead asks whether a Rapid Alert follows. What is the correct answer?
options: No, Class III falls outside the Rapid Alert procedure and is handled at national level.
Yes, within 24 hours, because recalled batches must be reported to the full recipient list.
Yes, at the same time as national action, because a recall of any class crosses borders.
No, unless EMA requests it, since Class III alerts are optional at the authority's discretion.
bank.expl:
- A: **Class III**는 Rapid Alert **미해당**이다. 국내에서 처리한다.
- B: 24시간 전파는 Class II다. Class III 회수는 Rapid Alert로 보내지 않는다.
- C: 동시 전파는 Class I이다.
- D: EMA 요청에 따른 선택 발신이라는 규정은 없다.

bank.title: purpose of the two systems
bank.stem: A global recall SOP must use both US DSCSA data and EU safety-feature data. Which statement correctly contrasts the two systems?
options: DSCSA verifies packs at dispensing and decommissions them, while EU safety features exchange TI/TH/TS data.
Both systems store the full chain of transactions, so either one can reconstruct the distribution route for a recall.
EU safety features serve traceability, while DSCSA serves mainly anti-falsification at the dispensing point.
DSCSA: traceability and anti-falsification; EU safety features: anti-falsification, with no transaction history.
bank.expl:
- D: DSCSA는 **추적성 + 위조 방지**, EU 2016/161은 **위조 방지**이고 거래 이력을 **저장하지 않는다**.
- A: 조제 시점 검증·decommission은 EU, TI/TH/TS 교환은 DSCSA다.
- B: EU 시스템엔 거래 이력이 없다.
- C: 두 목적이 뒤바뀌었다.

bank.title: reconstructing distribution
bank.stem: A recall must decide depth and reconcile quantities for one lot sold in the US and in Germany. Which data source answers the distribution-route question in each region?
options: In both regions, consignee responses alone, since neither system holds distribution data.
In both regions, the safety-feature repository, which records each pack's movement between traders.
In the US, DSCSA transaction data; in Germany, wholesale distribution records under Article 80.
In the US, wholesale records under Article 80; in Germany, DSCSA transaction data.
bank.expl:
- C: 미국은 **DSCSA** 거래 정보로 유통 경로를 재구성한다. EU는 decommission 기록으로 환자 도달 패키지를 확인하지만 경로 재구성은 **도매 기록(Art 80)** 에 의존한다.
- A: DSCSA는 유통 경로 데이터를 갖는다.
- B: EU 저장소에는 거래 간 이동 기록이 없다.
- D: 지역이 뒤바뀌었다.

bank.title: DSCSA duties
bank.stem: Which pair of DSCSA obligations is stated correctly?
options: Keep transaction data 6 years; notify FDA of illegitimate product within 24 hours on Form 3911.
Keep transaction data for 10 years; notify trading partners, with FDA informed on its request.
Keep transaction data for 2 years; notify FDA of illegitimate product within 10 working days of finding it.
Keep transaction data for 6 years; notify FDA of suspect product within 3 working days on a FAR.
bank.expl:
- A: DSCSA는 TI/TH/TS를 **6년** 보존하고, **불법(illegitimate) 제품**은 **24시간 내 FDA 통지(Form 3911)** + 거래 파트너 통지다.
- B: 10년은 근거가 없고, FDA 통지는 요청 시가 아니라 24시간 내 의무다.
- C: 10 working days는 806이다.
- D: FAR은 NDA/ANDA 품질 결함 보고다.

bank.title: donor later found HBV-positive
bank.stem: A cord-blood bank (361 HCT/P) learns that a distributed unit came from a donor later found HBV-positive. No recipient illness is known. Which report applies under 21 CFR 1271.350?
options: A deviation report within 45 days, since a distributed product carries a transmission risk.
An adverse reaction report within 15 days, since the donor result shows disease transmission.
A FAR within 3 working days, since the unit is a distributed product with a quality defect.
A BPDR within 45 days under 600.14, since cord blood is a biological product.
bank.expl:
- A: 배포된 제품의 핵심 요건 위반·전염병 전파 위험은 **1271.350(b) deviation 보고 45일**이다. 공여자 재평가(1271.75–85)와 격리·회수가 함께 간다.
- B: 15일은 수혜자에게 전염병 전파 관련 유해 반응이 확인될 때(350(a))다.
- C: FAR은 NDA/ANDA 보고다.
- D: BPDR은 351 제품(BLA) 체계다. 361 HCT/P에는 1271.350이 적용된다.

bank.title: recipient infected
bank.stem: Weeks later, a recipient of the same unit is found to have an HBV infection needing medical intervention. What additional report is due?
options: A second deviation report within 45 days, replacing the first one.
An IND safety report within 7 days, since infection is life-threatening.
An additional adverse reaction report within 15 days under 1271.350(a).
A Part 806 report within 10 working days, since the unit is returned.
bank.expl:
- C: 전염병 전파 관련 치명·생명 위협·영구 장애·**개입 필요** 유해 반응은 **1271.350(a) 15일** 보고다.
- A: deviation 보고를 대체하는 것이 아니라 유해 반응 보고가 추가된다.
- B: 312.32는 IND 체계다. 이 단위는 361 HCT/P다.
- D: 806은 기기 보고다.

bank.title: HCT/P order authority
bank.stem: The cord-blood bank declines to recall the remaining units from the same donor. What can FDA do?
options: Issue an order under PHS 351(d)(2), since cord blood counts as a licensed biologic in this setting.
Issue an order under 1271.440 requiring retention, recall, destruction or cessation.
Issue an order under 518(e), since the units are stored and shipped in device containers.
Nothing beyond a 7.45 request, since HCT/Ps share the drug rule that recall orders are unavailable.
bank.expl:
- B: HCT/P는 **1271.440**(PHS 361)으로 retention·recall·destruction·cessation 명령이 가능하다.
- A: 361 HCT/P는 licensed 생물의약품이 아니다. 351 제품이면 351(d)가 별도로 붙는다.
- C: 518(e)는 기기 조항이다.
- D: HCT/P는 일반 의약품과 달리 명령 권한이 있다.

bank.title: HCT/P traceability
bank.stem: In the cord-blood scenario, the bank must notify recipient institutions and trace recipients. Which records requirement supports this?
options: Tracking records under 1271.290, kept for 2 years after distribution.
Distribution records under 211.150, kept for 6 years as for drugs.
Transaction records under DSCSA, kept for 6 years by each trading partner.
Tracking records under 1271.290, retained for 10 years, to trace each unit.
bank.expl:
- D: HCT/P 추적성 기록은 **1271.290**이고 **10년** 보존이다.
- A: 2년은 근거가 없다.
- B: 211.150은 의약품 유통 기록이다.
- C: DSCSA는 처방약 패키지 체계다. HCT/P 추적성 근거가 아니다.

bank.title: US shortage notice
bank.stem: A US recall of a sole-source sterile injectable for a life-threatening condition will interrupt supply. Which US shortage obligations apply alongside the recall?
options: Not needed, since the recall notification under 7.46 already informs FDA of the supply impact.
A 506C notice 2 months in advance, with the shortage plan filed through ESMP for review.
A 506C notice once supply has run out, since a recall is an unforeseeable event.
A 506C notice 6 months ahead or, if not possible, promptly, and a 506C(j) risk management plan.
bank.expl:
- D: **506C**는 **6개월 전**, 불가능하면 즉시 통지이고, **506C(j)** 위험관리계획(CARES Act 2020)을 둔다. Drug Shortage Staff와 배분·임시 수입·유효기간 연장을 협의한다.
- A: 7.46 통지가 506C 통지를 대신하지 않는다.
- B: 2개월과 ESMP는 EU(Art 23a·CAP) 쪽이다.
- C: 공급이 끊긴 뒤가 아니라 미리, 불가능하면 즉시다.

bank.title: EU shortage for a CAP
bank.stem: The MAH of a centrally authorised oncology injectable must suspend supply after a recall. Which EU steps apply?
options: Report to the supervisory authority, which forwards shortage data to EMA under Chapter 8.
Notify under Article 23a 6 months ahead, with a risk management plan under section 506C(j).
Report via ESMP (mandatory since 2025-02-02) and notify under Article 23a 2 months ahead.
Report through ESMP once the MSSG has listed the product as a critical medicine.
bank.expl:
- C: CAP 부족은 **ESMP**(2025-02-02 의무)로 보고하고, **Art 23a**는 중단 **2개월 전**(불가피하면 즉시)이다. Art 81 공급 지속, MSSG(Reg 2022/123) 협의도 따른다.
- A: CAP 부족 보고 채널은 ESMP다.
- B: 6개월·506C(j)는 미국 규정이다.
- D: ESMP 보고는 critical medicines 지정과 무관한 의무다.

bank.title: recall versus supply
bank.stem: A Class II defect affects the only US-licensed lot of a life-sustaining biologic. A full recall would leave patients untreated. Which approach reflects the textbook?
options: A full consumer-level recall at once, since shortage concerns are not a basis for changing a recall strategy.
A documented benefit-risk decision with wholesale depth, a Dear HCP letter and temporary importation.
Deferring the recall, since a life-sustaining product should not be recalled while it is in shortage.
A market withdrawal instead of a recall, which avoids classification and publication while supply is short.
bank.expl:
- B: **환자 위해 vs 미치료 위해**를 문서화한 B/R 판단(임원 승인)으로 depth를 **wholesale로 제한**, **Dear HCP + 사용 지침**, 추가 시험 후 조건부 유통, **임시 수입**을 쓴다.
- A: 부족 고려로 depth·시기를 조정할 수 있다.
- C: 리콜을 미루는 것이 아니라 depth 제한·사용 지침 같은 조건을 붙여 진행한다.
- D: 위법 제품은 market withdrawal이 될 수 없다.

bank.title: when a public warning
bank.stem: Under 21 CFR 7.42, when is a public warning part of a recall strategy?
options: For most recalls, since recalls are already published in the weekly Enforcement Report.
When a serious hazard product reached consumers or users and other means may not reach them.
When FDA has issued a 7.45 request and the firm has refused to recall the product.
When the recall depth is wholesale level, so that downstream pharmacies and clinics learn of it.
bank.expl:
- B: 공중 경고는 **중대 건강 위험** 제품이 **소비자·사용자 수준까지 유통**됐고 다른 수단으로 닿기 어려울 때다(대개 Class I).
- A: Enforcement Report 공개와 공중 경고는 별개다.
- C: 요청 리콜 거부는 요건이 아니다.
- D: wholesale depth는 소비자 도달이 아니다.

bank.title: firm delays the press release
bank.stem: A firm in a Class I consumer-level recall drafts a press release but plans to hold it until FDA has fully reviewed the text. What does the 2019 guidance expect?
options: Holding the release is right, since FDA must clear the text of public statements about a recall.
Issue it promptly in plain language and share the draft; FDA may warn the public if needed.
Holding is right for Class II, but Class I press releases go out after FDA's comment.
The release is optional, since the Enforcement Report already serves as the public warning.
bank.expl:
- B: 2019 guidance는 회사가 **보도자료·웹 공지를 신속히**(평이한 언어·사진·로트·행동·MedWatch) 내고 FDA에 초안을 공유하되 검토를 기다리지 말라고 한다. 회사가 안 하거나 불충분하면 **FDA가 직접** 공중 경고를 낸다.
- A: FDA 사전 승인 요건은 없다.
- C: 등급으로 나누는 규칙이 아니다.
- D: Enforcement Report와 공중 경고는 별개다.

bank.title: termination request contents
bank.stem: A Class II recall has reached 92% product recovery after four months, and the remainder is presumed used. The firm prepares a request to terminate. Which package fits 21 CFR 7.53 and 7.55?
options: A statement that 92% exceeds the effectiveness level, which ends the recall without further FDA review.
A request to move the remaining quantity to market withdrawal status so the file can close early.
A copy of the original recall letter and FDA's classification notice, since those documents define the scope.
Consignee reconciliation, quantity reconciliation, disposition records and evidence of completed CAPA.
bank.expl:
- D: 최종 보고에는 수신처 통지·응답 **전수 대조**, **수량 대조**(출하 − 회수 − 소진 추정), 회수 제품 **처분** 기록, **근본 원인·CAPA** 완료 증거가 들어간다. FDA가 합리적 노력 완료로 보면 서면 종결한다.
- A: 회수율이 종결을 자동으로 정하지 않는다. FDA가 판단한다.
- B: 리콜 일부를 market withdrawal로 바꾸는 절차는 없다.
- C: 원래 통신문·분류 통지는 종결 근거 자료가 아니다.

bank.title: EU closure
bank.stem: The same product is recalled in the EU. Which closure steps fit Chapter 8 practice?
options: The MAH closes the recall itself once the Rapid Alert follow-up period has passed.
A closure report to the supervisory authority, QP records in the PQS, and variations as needed.
EMA closes the recall for the member states once it receives the US termination letter.
Each CMS closes the recall on its own timetable, without a report to the supervisory authority.
bank.expl:
- B: EU 종결은 **supervisory authority에 종결 보고**(회수율·처분·CAPA)를 내고, 당국이 CAPA를 확인한 뒤 종결한다. **QP가 PQS에 기록**하고 변경은 variation(Type IB/II)으로 한다.
- A: 회사가 스스로 종결하지 않는다.
- C: 미국 종결이 EU 종결을 대신하지 않는다.
- D: 종결 보고는 supervisory authority로 간다.

bank.title: new ADR, product within specification
bank.stem: Postmarketing data reveal a new serious adverse reaction. Every lot meets its specifications. The commercial team proposes a recall to show caution. Why is this generally not a recall situation?
options: Because new reactions are handled by the PSUR cycle and can wait for action until the next report.
Because a recall removes violative product, and this is a change in benefit-risk information.
Because recalls are reserved for Class I hazards, and a new reaction is graded below that level.
Because FDA cannot request recalls for products whose labeling it has already approved.
bank.expl:
- B: 리콜은 **위법 제품** 제거다. 규격 적합 제품의 새 안전성 신호는 결함이 아니라 **B/R 정보 변화**이고, 수단은 라벨 변경·**DHCP/DHPC**·REMS/aRMM·적응증 축소다.
- A: 정기 보고까지 기다리는 것은 과소 대응이다.
- C: 리콜은 Class I만이 아니다. 문제는 위법 여부다.
- D: 승인 라벨이 있어도 위법이면 7.45 요청이 가능하다.

bank.title: US tools for the new signal
bank.stem: Continuing the same case, which US actions fit the textbook?
options: An FAR within 3 working days, since a new serious reaction is a product quality defect.
A Part 7 recall at consumer level, with labeling unchanged until the recall is terminated.
A 505(o)(4) safety labeling change or CBE-0, a Dear HCP letter, and letters for older stock.
A market withdrawal of the affected lots, followed by an annual report describing the new risk.
bank.expl:
- C: **505(o)(4) SLC**·**CBE-0** 경고 강화, **Dear HCP letter**가 수단이다. 경고 누락으로 misbranded(502)가 될 수 있어 **경고 전 재고에는 서신**을 보낸다.
- A: FAR은 품질 결함 보고다. 새 ADR은 품질 결함이 아니다.
- B: 규격 적합 제품이라 리콜이 기본 수단이 아니다.
- D: market withdrawal은 수단이 아니고, 연차 보고로 미룰 사안도 아니다.

bank.title: exposure for doing too little
bank.stem: Which exposure does the textbook list for a firm that responds too little to a new safety signal?
options: A BPDR obligation within 45 days, since an unaddressed safety signal is a product deviation.
Missing a 505(o)(4) deadline of 30 days, EU Article 23 duties, and failure-to-warn liability.
A mandatory recall order under 518(e), which FDA can issue for any drug with a safety signal.
Loss of the marketing authorisation in the EU as a direct result of issuing a DHPC.
bank.expl:
- B: 과소 대응 노출은 **505(o)(4) 30일 미이행**(misbranding·민사벌금), EU **Art 23** 안전성 정보 통지 의무·Art 116, **제조물 책임(failure-to-warn)** 이다. 결정 기록에 "왜 리콜이 아닌가"를 적어둔다.
- A: BPDR은 BLA 유통 배치 편차 보고다.
- C: 518(e)는 기기 조항이다.
- D: DHPC 발행 자체가 허가 상실로 이어지지 않는다. DHPC는 과소 대응을 피하는 수단이다.

bank.title: exporting recovered units
bank.stem: A Class II lot is recalled in the US. The firm proposes to export the recovered units to a third country where the product is not yet registered. How should regulatory affairs respond?
options: Not allowed: adulterated or misbranded units cannot meet 801(e), so destroy or rework them.
Allowed, provided the importing country agrees in writing and the units are labeled for export.
Allowed under section 802, since the product is unapproved in the importing country.
Not allowed until FDA terminates the recall, after which remaining units may be exported.
bank.expl:
- A: 리콜 제품은 adulterated/misbranded라 **801(e)** 요건(수입국 규격 부합 등)을 충족할 수 없다. **폐기·재작업(211.115)** 이 길이다.
- B: 수입국 동의·표시만으로 결함 제품이 801(e)를 충족하지 못한다.
- C: 802도 품질 요건이 전제다.
- D: 종결 뒤에도 결함 제품은 결함 제품이다.

bank.title: EU view of the same export
bank.stem: Which EU provision requires the MAH to report the export action, and what does it cover?
options: Article 23a, which requires 2 months' notice of any shipment of product outside the EU.
Article 117a, which covers defects reported by patients and healthcare professionals in the EU.
Article 81, which covers continuity of supply in the EU and excludes third countries.
Article 123(2), which requires notice forthwith with reasons, including third-country actions.
bank.expl:
- D: **Art 123(2)**(Dir 2012/26)는 철회·정지·회수 등 조치를 **즉시(forthwith)** 사유와 통지하고 **제3국 조치를 포함**한다. 회수 제품 수출은 Art 117·GMP 위반 문제도 된다(QP 인증 불가).
- A: Art 23a는 시판 중단 통지다.
- B: Art 117a는 결함·위조 신고 시스템과 환자 도달 제품 회수 보장이다.
- C: Art 81은 공급 지속 의무다.

bank.title: shortened shelf life in distribution
bank.stem: A labelled 36-month expiry is supported only to 24 months after a stability failure at 30 months. Stock is at wholesalers and pharmacies. Which US actions are correct?
options: A market withdrawal of the stock, since stability failures are not violative until the product expires.
A recall for expired stock, while relabeling of in-date stock is handled without notice to FDA.
A BPDR within 45 days and a consumer-level recall, since potency loss affects the units sold.
A FAR within 3 working days, relabeling in-date stock as a correction, and removal of older stock.
bank.expl:
- D: 안정성 실패는 **FAR 3 working days**(314.81(b)(1)(ii)) 명시 사유다. 24개월 미경과 재고의 **재라벨은 correction = 리콜**이라 7.46 통지·분류 대상이고, 24개월 경과 재고는 **removal**이다. depth는 retail.
- A: 위법 제품이라 market withdrawal이 아니다.
- B: 재라벨도 리콜(correction)이다.
- C: BPDR은 BLA 보고다. 정제의 결함엔 FAR이 맞다.

bank.title: filing the shortening
bank.stem: In the same case, the firm must change the approved expiration dating period from 36 to 24 months. Which submission category applies under FDA's 2004 changes guidance?
options: An annual report, since shortening merely adds caution and leaves the specification unchanged.
A CBE-0 supplement, since the change strengthens the product's labeling.
A CBE-30 supplement, since shortening the period gives increased assurance.
A prior approval supplement, since any change to the expiry date needs approval.
bank.expl:
- C: 유효기간 **단축**(보증 강화 목적)은 **CBE-30 supplement**다(FDA 2004 *Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA*).
- A: 단축은 연차 보고가 아니다.
- B: CBE-0이 아니다.
- D: 단축에 사전 승인은 필요 없다.

bank.title: extending the shelf life
bank.stem: Two years later, full shelf-life data on production batches under the approved stability protocol support restoring a longer expiry. How is the extension reported in the US?
options: A CBE-30 supplement, since any change in expiration dating goes through a supplement.
A prior approval supplement, since an extension reduces assurance and needs approval.
A batch-record note, since the approved protocol already covers later expiry periods.
An annual report under 314.70(d)(2)(vi), based on the approved protocol data.
bank.expl:
- D: **승인 프로토콜**에 따른 **생산 배치 full shelf-life 데이터**로 연장하면 **annual report**(314.70(d)(2)(vi))다.
- A: CBE-30은 유효기간 단축에 쓴다. 이 조건의 연장은 supplement가 아니다.
- B: 이 조건의 연장은 사전 승인이 아니다.
- C: 배치 기록 메모로 끝나지 않는다. 승인 신청서의 유효기간이 바뀌므로 연차 보고로 알린다.

bank.title: extension on pilot data
bank.stem: A firm wants to extend expiry using data from pilot batches tested under a new protocol not yet approved. Which category applies?
options: An annual report, since the extension is supported by real-time stability data.
A prior approval supplement, since the data are not from an approved protocol.
A CBE-30 supplement, the same category used for shortening an expiry period.
Wait to file anything until production batches complete the full shelf-life period.
bank.expl:
- B: 연장이 annual report가 되려면 **승인 프로토콜 + 생산 배치 full shelf-life 데이터**여야 한다. 그 밖의 연장(미승인 프로토콜·파일럿 배치 데이터)은 **PAS**다.
- A: 연차 보고는 승인 프로토콜·생산 배치 full shelf-life 데이터일 때다.
- C: CBE-30은 유효기간 **단축**(보증 강화) 범주다. 연장에는 쓰지 않는다.
- D: 생산 배치 데이터를 기다리는 것도 선택지지만, 지금 이 데이터로 연장하려면 PAS를 낸다.

bank.title: EU shortening
bank.stem: In the EU, the same shortening of shelf life is filed as which variation type?
options: Type IB, since shortening is a notification that must wait 30 days.
A Chapter 8 notice in place of a variation, since the recall notice covers the change.
Type IAIN, under classification Q.II.f.1 of the EU Variations Guidelines.
Type II, since any change to shelf life needs a full scientific assessment.
bank.expl:
- C: 유효기간 **단축**은 EU Variations Guidelines **Q.II.f.1(a)** 상 **Type IAIN**(즉시 통지하는 IA)이다.
- A·D: 단축은 IA(IAIN)로 분류된다.
- B: Ch.8 통지가 variation을 대신하지 않는다.

bank.title: EU GMP Chapter 8 duties
bank.stem: Which statement reflects EU GMP Chapter 8 (2015)?
options: Human error is the default root cause where other causes cannot be shown within the set period.
Defects that could lead to a recall or abnormal supply restriction are notified without delay.
Mock recalls are needed once a real recall has failed its effectiveness check.
Investigational products and falsified products fall outside the Chapter 8 notification duty.
bank.expl:
- B: 리콜이나 **비정상 공급 제한**으로 이어질 수 있는 결함은 **지체 없이** 당국(+CAP은 EMA)에 통지한다.
- A: Ch.8은 "사람 실수"를 기본 원인으로 두지 말라고 한다.
- C: mock recall은 **정기** 평가다.
- D: 위조·IMP도 포함된다.

bank.title: EV endotoxin OOS, US side
bank.stem: An endotoxin OOS is found on a released EV lot after three patients at a US trial site received it. One patient had fever. Which US actions fit?
options: A FAR within 3 working days and a Class III recall, since a single patient had a mild reaction.
A BPDR within 45 days, since a trial product falls outside Part 7 recalls and their classification.
A market withdrawal of unused units and an annual report, since the use is investigational.
Quarantine unused units, report under 312.32 with IRB notice, and run a Class I user-level recall.
bank.expl:
- D: 미투여분 **즉시 격리**, IND 분은 **312.32 7/15일** + IRB 통지다. 주사제 엔도톡신은 **Class I**, user level·effectiveness A, 환자 추적이 따른다. 승인 제품분이면 BPDR 45일·15-day 보고가 붙는다.
- A: FAR은 NDA/ANDA 보고이고, 주사제 엔도톡신은 Class I 기본값이다.
- B: IMP도 Enforcement Report에 게재될 수 있고 회수를 진행한다.
- C: 위법 제품이라 market withdrawal이 아니다.

bank.title: EV endotoxin, EU side
bank.stem: Two patients in an EU hospital also received the lot under a central approval, and other units went to an EU trial. Which EU actions fit?
options: Notify EMA and the supervisory authority without delay, a Class I Rapid Alert at once, and CTR Article 52/54.
Notify the NCA where the hospital sits, with a Class II Rapid Alert within 24 hours after the root cause is known.
Notify EMA first, then send a DHPC after the PSUR confirms the endotoxin signal in the next cycle.
Notify the supervisory authority, since a Rapid Alert is not used for products that were given in clinical trials.
bank.expl:
- A: Ch.8 **지체 없이 EMA + supervisory authority**, **Art 123(2)**, **Class I Rapid Alert 즉시**, DHPC, ICSR 15일, IMP 분은 **CTR Art 52/54 7일**이다.
- B: 엔도톡신 주사제는 Class I이고, 근본 원인 확인을 기다리지 않는다.
- C: CAP 결함은 EMA와 supervisory authority 둘 다다. PSUR까지 기다리지 않는다.
- D: IMP도 Rapid Alert 대상이 될 수 있다.

bank.title: effectiveness check sizing
bank.stem: A Class III recall reaches 500 retail consignees, and FDA accepts effectiveness check Level D. A second Class II recall reaches 300 consignees at Level C. How many consignees must be checked in each recall?
options: 10 in the first recall and 30 in the second.
20 in the first recall and 150 in the second.
2 in the first recall and 10 in the second.
50 in the first recall and 60 in the second.
bank.expl:
- A: Level **D는 2%**, Level **C는 10%**다. 500 × 2% = 10, 300 × 10% = 30.
- B: 4%·50%로 계산한 값이다. Level B는 10% 초과~100% 미만이라 정해진 비율이 없다.
- C: 백분율 숫자를 수신처 수로 옮겨 적었다.
- D: 두 Level을 10%·20%로 잘못 적용했다.

bank.title: 15-day Alert report trigger
bank.stem: Under 21 CFR 314.80, which adverse drug experiences must an NDA holder submit as 15-day Alert reports?
options: Serious adverse experiences, whether or not they are described in the current labeling.
Fatal or life-threatening experiences within 15 days, with other serious cases left to periodic reports.
Unexpected adverse experiences of any severity, provided they occur in the United States.
Serious and unexpected adverse experiences, from any source, domestic or foreign.
bank.expl:
- D: 15-day Alert report의 조건은 **serious AND unexpected**이고 출처를 가리지 않는다(국내·해외·문헌·시판 후 연구). 314.80의 뼈대다.
- A: 모든 serious를 신속 보고하는 것은 EU Art 107(3) 방식이다. 미국은 라벨에 있는 serious 사례를 periodic으로 보낸다.
- B: 치명·생명위협만 떼어 보는 구분은 IND의 312.32(7일) 방식이다. 시판 후 15-day는 serious·unexpected 사례 전체가 대상이다.
- C: serious 조건이 빠졌고, 해외 사례도 314.80 대상이다.

bank.title: 15-day clock from awareness
bank.stem: On 3 March a company's safety unit first receives a report containing an identifiable patient, reporter, suspect drug and a serious event that is not in the USPI. By when is the 15-day Alert report due?
options: 18 March, counting 15 calendar days from first receipt of the minimum information.
18 March, but the clock starts once the company has concluded that the drug caused the event.
2 April, counting 30 days, because initial reports go into the next quarterly periodic report.
13 March, counting 10 calendar days from first receipt of the minimum information.
bank.expl:
- A: 시계는 최소 4요소를 **처음 인지한 날**이 day 0이고 **15 calendar days**다. 3월 3일 + 15일 = **3월 18일**.
- B: 자발 보고는 인과성을 **추정**한다(ICH E2D). 회사가 인과성을 먼저 확정할 필요가 없다.
- C: 분기 종료 30일은 periodic 보고의 기한이다. serious·unexpected 사례는 periodic을 기다리지 않는다.
- D: 10일은 314.80 기한이 아니다. 15-day Alert report는 15 calendar days다.

bank.title: follow-up of a 15-day report
bank.stem: A company submitted a 15-day Alert report for a case of liver failure. Three weeks later the treating physician sends the biopsy result and the outcome. What does 314.80 require?
options: A follow-up report within 30 days, or inclusion in the next periodic report.
A follow-up report within 15 calendar days of receiving the new information.
A new initial 15-day report, because each new piece of information opens a new case.
A follow-up report when FDA requests it in writing; otherwise the case stays closed.
bank.expl:
- B: 314.80의 **follow-up**도 새 정보 인지 후 **15일**이다.
- A: 30일은 periodic 분기 보고의 기한이다. follow-up은 15일이다.
- C: 같은 사례의 새 정보는 follow-up으로 낸다. 새 사례로 쪼개지 않는다.
- D: follow-up은 회사의 의무다. FDA 요청을 기다리지 않는다.

bank.title: US periodic reporting schedule
bank.stem: An NDA was approved recently. What periodic adverse drug experience reporting schedule applies by default under 314.80?
options: Quarterly for 3 years, due 30 days after each quarter; then annually, due 60 days after the anniversary.
Semi-annually for 2 years, then annually; each report due within 70 days of its data lock point.
Quarterly for 5 years, due 30 days after each quarter; then annually, due 60 days after the anniversary.
Annually from approval, due within 60 days of the anniversary, with quarterly reports added on FDA request.
bank.expl:
- A: 승인 후 **3년은 분기별**(분기 종료 **30일 내**), 그 뒤 **연 1회**(승인 기념일 **60일 내**)다.
- B: 70일은 EU PSUR(주기 ≤12개월) 기한이다. 미국 PADER 일정과 섞었다.
- C: 분기 기간은 5년이 아니라 3년이다.
- D: 분기 보고가 기본이고 FDA 요청으로 생기는 것이 아니다.

bank.title: quarterly PADER date
bank.stem: An NDA approved 14 months ago is still in its quarterly periodic reporting phase. The current quarter ends 30 September. When is the periodic report due?
options: 15 October, 15 days after the quarter ends, matching the Alert report clock.
9 December, 70 days after the quarter ends, matching the PSUR clock.
29 November, 60 days after the quarter ends, as for annual reports.
30 October, 30 days after the end of the reporting quarter in question.
bank.expl:
- D: 승인 3년 이내이므로 분기 보고이고, 분기 종료 후 **30일**이다. 9월 30일 + 30일 = **10월 30일**.
- A: 15일은 개별 15-day 보고 시계다. 주기 보고와 다르다.
- B: 70일은 EU PSUR 기한이다.
- C: 60일은 3년 뒤 연간 보고(기념일 기준)의 기한이다.

bank.title: annual PADER date
bank.stem: An NDA approved on 15 May five years ago now reports annually under 314.80. When is this year's periodic report due?
options: 14 July, 60 days after the approval anniversary.
14 June, 30 days after the approval anniversary.
24 July, 70 days after the approval anniversary.
13 August, 90 days after the approval anniversary.
bank.expl:
- A: 승인 3년이 지나면 연간 보고이고, 기한은 승인 기념일 후 **60일**이다. 5월 15일 + 60일 = **7월 14일**(5월 16일, 6월 30일, 7월 14일).
- B: 30일은 분기 보고의 기한이다.
- C: 70일은 EU PSUR(주기 ≤12개월) 기한이다.
- D: 90일은 EU PSUR(주기 >12개월) 기한이다.

bank.title: PADER vs PBRER
bank.stem: How can a US NDA holder submit an ICH E2C(R2) PBRER instead of the PADER?
options: By including the PBRER in the annual report under 314.81, which replaces 314.80 periodic reporting.
By filing the PBRER in place of the PADER once the product is also authorised in the EU.
By requesting a waiver under 314.80(c)(2)(i), as described in FDA's 2016 guidance.
By obtaining PRAC agreement, which FDA accepts through its confidentiality arrangement with EMA.
bank.expl:
- C: **314.80(c)(2)(i) waiver**를 받아 PADER 대신 **PBRER**를 낸다(FDA 2016 guidance). DLP를 EURD에 맞추는 실무 경로다.
- A: 314.81 annual report는 periodic 안전성 보고를 대체하지 않는다.
- B: EU 허가가 있다고 자동으로 바뀌지 않는다. waiver가 필요하다.
- D: PRAC은 미국 보고 형식을 정하지 않는다.

bank.title: US definition of serious
bank.stem: A case processor must decide whether four US reports are serious. Which outcome is NOT among the criteria that make an adverse drug experience "serious" under 21 CFR 314.80(a)?
options: A congenital anomaly or birth defect.
Inpatient hospitalisation or prolongation of an existing hospitalisation.
An important medical event that may require intervention to prevent a listed outcome.
An event that is severe in intensity but has none of the listed outcomes.
bank.expl:
- D: serious는 **결과**로 정한다. 강도가 심하다(severe)는 것만으로는 serious가 아니다.
- A: 선천 이상은 serious 기준이다.
- B: 입원(신규·연장)은 serious 기준이다.
- C: **기타 의학적으로 중요한 사건**도 serious 기준에 들어간다.

bank.title: US definition of unexpected
bank.stem: A US case report describes a serious event that the company's safety physician wants to classify. The company holds several reference documents for the product. For 314.80 purposes, when is the event "unexpected"?
options: When it is not listed in the Investigator's Brochure that supported the pivotal clinical trials.
When it is not listed in the company core safety information, which serves as the global reference.
When it is not listed in the EU SmPC, which FDA accepts as equivalent product information.
When it is absent from the current USPI, or more severe or specific than the USPI describes.
bank.expl:
- D: 미국 expectedness는 **현행 라벨(USPI)** 기준이다. 라벨에 없거나 더 중증·특이적이면 unexpected다.
- A: IB의 RSI는 임상시험(312.32·SUSAR) 기준이다.
- B: CCSI는 PSUR/PBRER의 **listedness** 기준이다.
- C: SmPC로 미국 15-day를 판단하는 것은 교과서가 든 대표 오류다.

bank.title: four reference documents
bank.stem: A global safety unit keeps making errors: some US 15-day reports are missed and some SUSARs are misclassified. An audit finds that case assessors pick whichever label is to hand. Which assignment of reference documents removes these errors?
options: IB for US 15-day expectedness; SmPC for PSUR listedness; CCSI for 312.32 expectedness.
SmPC for US 15-day expectedness; USPI for SUSAR expectedness; CCSI for EU ICSR submission.
USPI for US 15-day expectedness; CCSI for PBRER listedness; IB RSI for SUSARs.
USPI for PSUR listedness; CCSI for US 15-day expectedness; IB for EU ICSR seriousness.
bank.expl:
- C: **USPI** → 미국 314.80 expectedness, **CCSI** → PSUR/PBRER listedness, **IB의 RSI** → 임상 SUSAR·312.32 expectedness다. EU ICSR 제출 요건에는 예상성이 없다.
- A: IB는 시판 후 15-day 기준이 아니다.
- B: SmPC로 미국 판단, USPI로 SUSAR 판단 — 교과서가 든 오류 패턴 두 개다.
- D: USPI와 CCSI의 역할이 뒤바뀌었다.

bank.title: foreign literature case, US
bank.stem: A company finds a case of fatal hepatotoxicity in a foreign journal article. The product is approved in the US, and hepatotoxicity does not appear in the USPI. Which US action applies?
options: A 15-day Alert report with a copy of the article, because foreign and literature cases are in scope.
Not reportable in the US, because the event occurred abroad and was not sent to the company directly.
Inclusion in the next periodic report, because published cases are already in the public domain.
A 7-day telephone report to FDA, because the outcome was fatal and the event is unlabeled.
bank.expl:
- A: 314.80은 **해외·문헌** 사례도 포함한다. 사망 = serious, 라벨에 없음 = unexpected → **15-day**이고 문헌 사본을 붙인다.
- B: 출처 불문이다. 해외 사례도 대상이다.
- C: 공개된 문헌이라는 이유로 신속 보고가 면제되지 않는다.
- D: 7일 보고는 IND의 312.32다. 시판 후에는 15-day다.

bank.title: MedWatch forms
bank.stem: Which pairing of MedWatch forms is correct?
options: Form 3500 for mandatory manufacturer reports; Form 3500A for voluntary reports by health professionals.
Form 3500A for vaccine reports; Form 3500 for drug and device reports from any type of reporter.
Form 3500 for voluntary reports; Form 3500A for mandatory reports by manufacturers and applicants.
Form 3500B for mandatory device reports; Form 3500A for consumer reports written in plain language.
bank.expl:
- C: **3500**은 HCP·소비자의 **자발** 보고, **3500A**는 MAH 등의 **의무** 보고다. 의약품 의무 보고는 전자 E2B로 낸다.
- A: 자발과 의무가 뒤바뀌었다.
- B: 백신은 VAERS로 간다. 3500A는 의무 보고 양식이다.
- D: 3500B는 소비자용 평이한 자발 양식이다. 의무 보고 양식이 아니다.

bank.title: FDA database on the reference date
bank.stem: As of 1 September 2026, which statement about the FDA adverse event database is correct?
options: AEMS launched on 11 March 2026, consolidating FAERS, VAERS and AERS into one monitoring system.
FAERS remains a separate database, and AEMS is planned to replace it after the reference date.
AEMS covers device reports, while FAERS continues to hold drug and biologic reports.
AEMS replaced MedWatch Forms, so paper and online voluntary reports have been discontinued.
bank.expl:
- A: FDA **AEMS**는 **2026-03-11** 출범했고 FAERS·VAERS·AERS를 통합했다. 기준일에는 FAERS = AEMS다(교재는 FAERS로 기술).
- B: 출범이 기준일 이전이다.
- C: 의약품·백신 DB가 통합 대상이다. MAUDE 등 기기 DB는 뒤에 추가된다.
- D: AEMS는 데이터베이스 통합이다. 자발 보고 양식을 없앤 것이 아니다.

bank.title: E2B(R3) on the reference date
bank.stem: On 1 September 2026, a US applicant asks which electronic ICSR format FDA requires. What is the correct answer?
options: E2B(R2) for IND and postmarketing ICSRs, because FDA has accepted R3 on a voluntary basis since 2024 without a mandatory date.
E2B(R3) for both IND and postmarketing ICSRs, mandatory for each since 1 April 2026 under one FDA notice.
E2B(R3) for postmarketing ICSRs since 2017, matching the EudraVigilance go-live, with IND reports following in 2026.
E2B(R3) for IND reports since 1 April 2026; postmarketing R3 is due 1 October 2026, not applicable on the reference date.
bank.expl:
- D: FDA E2B(R3) 의무는 **IND 2026-04-01**, **시판 후 2026-10-01**이다. 시판 후 의무는 기준일 시점 비적용이고, 그때까지 R2를 쓸 수 있다.
- A: 2024-01-16부터는 자발 수용이었지만 IND는 2026-04-01부터 의무다.
- B: 시판 후 의무 시점을 앞당겼다.
- C: 2017은 EU EudraVigilance 가동이다. FDA 일정이 아니다.

bank.title: US record retention
bank.stem: An NDA holder plans to archive and then destroy old case files to save storage costs. Under 314.80(i), how long must it keep postmarketing adverse drug experience reports and related records?
options: 2 years.
30 years.
10 years.
5 years.
bank.expl:
- C: **314.80(i)** 기록 보존은 **10년**이다. PADE 사찰에서 확인한다.
- A: 2년은 IND 기록(312.57)이다.
- B: 30년은 EU ATMP 공여자 추적성(Reg 1394/2007 Art 15)이다.
- D: 5년은 EU PSMF 기록(IR 520/2012 Art 12)이다.

bank.stem: To which products does 21 CFR 310.305 apply its 15-day reporting requirement?
options: Drugs marketed without an approved application.
Combination products with a device constituent part.
Investigational drugs used under an IND.
Biological products licensed under a BLA.
bank.expl:
- A: **310.305**는 **승인 신청 없이 시판되는** 의약품의 15-day 보고 규정이다.
- B: 콤비 제품은 **Part 4 Subpart B**다.
- C: IND 시험약은 **312.32**다.
- D: BLA 생물의약품은 **600.80**이다.

bank.title: 505(o)(3) and ARIA
bank.stem: During negotiations, a sponsor argues that a proposed postmarketing requirement is not permitted because the question could be answered with Sentinel data. Under FD&C 505(o)(3), when may FDA require a postmarketing study or clinical trial for a serious risk?
options: When the EU has already imposed a category 1 PASS on the same product for the same risk.
Whenever the review division considers additional data desirable, without any further statutory condition.
When the sponsor has voluntarily offered the study as a commitment during the review.
When FDA finds that the Sentinel ARIA system is not sufficient to address the question.
bank.expl:
- D: **505(o)(3)(D)** — ARIA(Sentinel)로 충분하면 PMR을 부과할 수 없다. ARIA 불충분 판단이 먼저다.
- A: EU 조치는 미국 PMR의 요건이 아니다.
- B: 법정 요건(serious risk 평가 목적, ARIA 불충분)이 있다.
- C: 자발 약속은 PMC다. PMR은 FDA가 부과한다.

bank.title: 505(o)(4) clock
bank.stem: FDA notifies an NDA holder of new safety information that should be added to the labeling under 505(o)(4). What is the statutory sequence?
options: Respond within 60 days with a supplement; if FDA disagrees, the matter goes to an advisory committee before any order.
15 days to submit a supplement; FDA may then order the change, with 30 days to comply with the order.
Respond within 30 days with a supplement; rebuttal is not available once FDA has issued the notification letter.
30 days to submit a supplement or rebuttal; discussion up to 30 days; after an order, 15 days to submit.
bank.expl:
- D: 505(o)(4)는 통지 → **30일** 내 보충(CBE-0/PAS) 또는 반박 → 논의 **≤30일** → **order** → **15일** 내 보충이다. 불이행은 502(z) misbranding이다.
- A: 60일과 자문위원회 단계는 505(o)(4) 절차에 없다.
- B: 15일과 30일의 위치가 뒤바뀌었다.
- C: 반박은 법정 선택지다. 문구 조정에 효과적이다.

bank.title: REMS assessment timetable
bank.stem: What minimum timetable for submission of REMS assessments does FD&C 505-1 set?
options: 2 years, 4 years and 6 years after approval.
1 year, 5 years and 10 years after approval.
18 months, 3 years and 7 years after approval.
6 months, 12 months and 3 years after approval.
bank.expl:
- C: REMS 평가는 승인 후 **18개월·3년·7년**이다(505-1(g)).
- A·B·D: 법정 시간표가 아니다. 숫자 바꿔치기다.

bank.title: REMS assessment date
bank.stem: A product with a REMS was approved on 1 January 2025. When is the first REMS assessment due under the minimum statutory timetable?
options: 1 January 2028, 3 years after approval.
1 July 2025, 6 months after approval.
1 January 2026, 12 months after approval.
1 July 2026, 18 months after approval.
bank.expl:
- D: 첫 평가는 승인 후 **18개월**이다. 2025-01-01 + 18개월 = **2026-07-01**.
- A: 3년은 두 번째 평가다.
- B: 6개월은 시간표에 없다.
- C: 12개월은 시간표에 없다.

bank.title: REMS elements
bank.stem: Which list contains only elements that a REMS may include under FD&C 505-1?
options: Elements to assure safe use, QPPV appointment, educational materials, EURD listing.
Patient package insert, imposed PASS, safety specification, periodic benefit-risk evaluation report.
Medication Guide, communication plan, elements to assure safe use, implementation system.
Medication Guide, PSMF summary, communication plan, additional monitoring symbol.
bank.expl:
- C: REMS 요소는 **Medication Guide/PPI · communication plan · ETASU · implementation system**(+ 평가 시간표)다.
- A: QPPV·EURD는 EU 제도다.
- B: imposed PASS·안전성 명세는 EU RMP 쪽이고, PBRER는 주기 보고다.
- D: PSMF 요약·역삼각은 EU 도구다.

bank.title: post-approval REMS proposal
bank.stem: FDA becomes aware of new safety information and notifies the holder of an approved NDA that a REMS is necessary. Within what period must the holder submit a proposed REMS?
options: 60 days, or a different period that FDA specifies.
120 days, or a different period that FDA specifies.
18 months, aligned with the first scheduled REMS assessment.
30 days, or a different period that FDA specifies.
bank.expl:
- B: 승인 후 REMS는 "new safety information" 근거로 요구되고, FDA 통지 후 **120일 내**(또는 FDA가 정한 다른 기한) 제안한다(505-1(a)(2)).
- A: 60일은 법정 기한이 아니다.
- C: 18개월은 REMS 평가 시간표다.
- D: 30일은 505(o)(4) 라벨 변경 응답 기한이다.

bank.title: shared system REMS
bank.stem: A generic version of a drug whose RLD has a REMS with ETASU is approved. What does 505-1(i) generally require?
options: The generic is exempt from REMS requirements because bioequivalence has been shown.
The generic files periodic REMS assessments starting after the RLD's 7-year assessment.
The generic sponsor designs its own separate REMS, with elements different from the RLD's.
It uses a single shared REMS with the RLD, unless FDA permits a separate one.
bank.expl:
- D: ETASU REMS가 있는 RLD의 제네릭은 **shared system REMS**를 쓴다. FDA가 분리를 허용할 수 있다.
- A: 생동성은 REMS 면제 사유가 아니다.
- B: 그런 일정 규정은 없다.
- C: 원칙은 공유 시스템이다.

bank.title: Sentinel and FDAAA
bank.stem: Which statement about FDA's Sentinel system is correct?
options: Sentinel is operated by MAHs under 314.80(b), each running analyses on its own products' claims data.
Sentinel was created by FDAAA section 921, which also requires FDA to publish quarterly REMS assessments.
It comes from FDAAA section 905, has been fully operational since 2016 and runs ARIA analyses.
Sentinel is a spontaneous reporting database that replaced MedWatch Form 3500 for consumer reports in 2016.
bank.expl:
- C: Sentinel은 **FDAAA 905**, **2016 완전 가동**, 보험·EHR **분산 DB**에서 **ARIA** 능동 분석을 한다.
- A: FDA가 운영한다. 314.80(b)는 MAH의 정보 검토 절차 의무다.
- B: 921은 **분기별 잠재 신호 공개**다. REMS 평가가 아니다.
- D: 자발 보고 DB는 AEMS(옛 FAERS)다. Sentinel은 능동 감시다.

bank.title: US vs EU active surveillance model
bank.stem: Which statement best captures how the US and EU differ in who generates postmarket safety evidence?
options: The EU uses public active surveillance first and imposes a PASS when DARWIN EU cannot answer the question.
The US relies on MAH-run active monitoring of EudraVigilance-type data, while EU authorities run their own claims-data network.
Both regions place the duty on the MAH alone, and neither authority operates its own active surveillance data sources.
The US puts public surveillance first, with PMRs when ARIA is insufficient; the EU puts monitoring and study duties on MAHs.
bank.expl:
- D: 미국은 **FDA 주도 Sentinel/ARIA + MAH 수동 보고**, PMR은 ARIA가 답하지 못할 때만이다. EU는 **MAH 모니터링·PASS 의무**, PRAC 감독이다.
- A: EU에는 505(o)(3)(D) 같은 "공공 인프라 불충분" 전제 규정이 없다. 그것은 미국 구조다.
- B: 두 지역이 뒤바뀌었다.
- C: FDA는 Sentinel을 운영한다.

bank.title: combination product information sharing
bank.stem: A drug and a separately marketed device are cross-labeled for use together, each under its own application. The drug applicant receives an adverse event report that involves the device. Under 21 CFR 4.103, what must it do?
options: Share the information with the device applicant within 5 calendar days.
Forward the report to FDA alone, since the device applicant may not see drug safety data.
Hold the information until the next periodic report and share it then.
Share the information with the device applicant within 30 calendar days.
bank.expl:
- A: cross-labeled 콤비는 각 구성품 신청자가 자기 체계로 보고하고, 상대 신청자와 **5 calendar days 내** 정보를 공유한다(4.103).
- B: 공유가 의무다.
- C: 주기 보고를 기다리지 않는다.
- D: 30일은 803 malfunction 보고 기한이다.

bank.title: Part 4 Subpart B additions
bank.stem: A BLA holder's product includes a device constituent part. Which additional reports does 21 CFR Part 4 Subpart B bring into its postmarketing safety reporting?
options: 803 5-day reports, 803 malfunction 30-day reports and 806 correction and removal reports.
312.32 7-day reports, BPDRs within 45 days and PSURs within 70 days of the data lock point.
EU Article 107 non-serious reports within 90 days and 803 5-day reports for each device event.
314.81 field alert reports within 3 working days and quarterly PADERs for 5 years.
bank.expl:
- A: Part 4 Subpart B는 신청 경로 보고에 기기 체계의 **803 5-day**, **malfunction 30-day**, **806 10 working days**를 더한다. 집행은 2020-07-31부터다.
- B: 312.32는 IND, PSUR는 EU다. BPDR은 원래 생물 체계 보고다.
- C: EU 규정은 미국 Part 4와 관계없다.
- D: FAR은 의약품 신청자의 품질 보고이고, 분기 PADER는 3년이다.

bank.title: 312.32 timelines
bank.stem: Under 21 CFR 312.32, what are the IND safety report timelines?
options: 15 calendar days for serious suspected adverse reactions, and 90 days for non-serious ones.
15 calendar days for suspected adverse reactions; fatal cases are added to the annual report.
7 days for unexpected fatal or life-threatening suspected reactions; 15 days for other serious unexpected ones.
7 calendar days for any serious adverse event, whatever its causality or expectedness.
bank.expl:
- C: 312.32는 **7일**(치명·생명위협 예상 밖 SAR) / **15일**(serious 예상 밖 SAR 등)이다. 근간은 ICH E2A다.
- A: 15/90일은 EU 시판 후 ICSR 구조다.
- B: 치명 사례가 7일 대상이다.
- D: suspected adverse reaction(합리적 가능성)과 예상성 조건이 빠졌다.

bank.title: IND reference document
bank.stem: In a Phase 3 trial of an approved drug used for a new indication, a serious event occurs that is listed in the USPI but not in the Investigator's Brochure reference safety information. Which reference determines expectedness for the IND safety report?
options: The CCSI, because it is the company's single global reference.
The USPI, because the drug is already approved in the United States.
The EU SmPC, because it is the most recently updated label.
The reference safety information section of the Investigator's Brochure.
bank.expl:
- D: 임상 SUSAR·312.32 expectedness는 **IB의 RSI**로 판단한다. 승인 라벨이 아니다.
- A: CCSI는 PSUR listedness 기준이다.
- B: IB 대신 USPI로 판단하는 것은 교과서가 든 오류 패턴이다.
- C: SmPC는 임상 expectedness 기준이 아니다.

bank.title: EU legal architecture
bank.stem: Which legal instruments form the core of the EU pharmacovigilance reform that applied from July 2012?
options: Implementing Regulation 2025/1466 and Implementing Regulation 520/2012.
Directive 2012/26 and Regulation 1027/2012.
Directive 2010/84 and Regulation 1235/2010.
Directive 2001/20 and Regulation 1394/2007.
bank.expl:
- C: 2010 개혁은 **Dir 2010/84**(Dir 2001/83 Title IX 개정) + **Reg 1235/2010**(Reg 726/2004 개정)이고 **2012-07** 적용이다.
- A: IR 520/2012와 이를 고친 IR 2025/1466은 PSMF·PSUR·RMP·신호를 상세화한 시행 규정이다. 개혁의 핵심 법은 아니다.
- B: Dir 2012/26·Reg 1027/2012는 Mediator 후 2013 개정이다.
- D: 임상시험 지침과 ATMP 규정이다.

bank.title: PRAC
bank.stem: Which committee centrally assesses pharmacovigilance issues in the EU, and where is it established?
options: PRAC, under Article 56 of Regulation 726/2004.
PRAC, under Article 104 of Directive 2001/83.
CMDh, under Article 31 of Directive 2001/83.
CHMP, under Article 107i of Directive 2001/83.
bank.expl:
- A: **PRAC**은 Reg 726/2004 **Art 56**에 근거한 PV 평가 위원회이고 2012-07부터 활동한다.
- B: Art 104는 MAH의 PV 시스템·QPPV·PSMF 조항이다.
- C: CMDh는 국가 허가 제품 쪽 조정 그룹이다.
- D: CHMP는 PRAC 권고를 CAP에 대해 채택한다. 107i는 긴급 절차 조항이다.

bank.title: Mediator amendment
bank.stem: What did Directive 2012/26, adopted after the benfluorex (Mediator) case, mainly add to the EU system?
options: A duty to state the true reasons for withdrawing or suspending a product, including abroad, and wider use of Article 107i.
Mandatory risk management plans for generics, with the same full content as required for the reference product.
A requirement that non-serious cases from third countries be reported to EudraVigilance within 90 days.
The creation of PRAC and the qualified person for pharmacovigilance, neither of which existed in EU law before.
bank.expl:
- A: Dir 2012/26은 MAH가 철회·중단·미갱신의 **진짜 사유**를 **Art 123(2)·23a**로 통지(제3국 포함)하게 하고 **Art 107i 자동 발동**을 넓혔다. 핵심은 MAH 투명성이다.
- B: 제네릭 RMP는 간소다.
- C: non-serious 90일은 EU 발생 사례에만 적용된다.
- D: PRAC·QPPV는 2010 개혁에서 나왔다.

bank.title: EU adverse reaction definition
bank.stem: After Directive 2010/84, which situations fall within the EU definition of an adverse reaction under Article 1(11) of Directive 2001/83?
options: Reactions arising from any use, provided they meet the definition of serious.
Reactions arising from off-label use when a healthcare professional prescribed the product.
Authorised use, plus medication errors, misuse, abuse, off-label use and occupational exposure.
Reactions arising from use within the terms of the marketing authorisation, as defined before the reform.
bank.expl:
- C: Art 1(11)의 adverse reaction은 승인 용법 외에 **투약 오류·오용·남용·허가 외 사용·직업 노출**에서 생긴 반응까지 포함한다.
- A: non-serious 반응도 정의에 들어가고 EU 발생분은 90일 보고 대상이다.
- B: 처방자 조건은 없다.
- D: 2010 개혁 전 범위에 가깝다. 정의 확대가 개혁의 첫 처방이었다.

bank.title: three EU reports
bank.stem: Three EU reports arrive: (a) a nurse gave twice the dose and the patient had no adverse effect; (b) a patient used the drug off-label and was hospitalised; (c) a pharmacist developed non-serious dermatitis while handling the product. Which ICSR obligations apply?
options: (a) 15-day ICSR; (b) 15-day ICSR; (c) not reportable, because occupational exposure is not patient use.
(a) not an ICSR, but record the medication error; (b) 15-day ICSR; (c) ICSR within 90 days.
(a) not reportable; (b) not reportable, as off-label use is the prescriber's responsibility; (c) 15-day ICSR.
(a) 90-day ICSR; (b) 90-day ICSR, because off-label use is outside the authorisation; (c) not reportable.
bank.expl:
- B: (a) 유해 반응이 없으므로 ICSR이 아니다(투약 오류 기록·PSUR 분석). (b) 허가 외 사용 + 입원 = serious → **15일**. (c) 직업 노출 피부염은 ICSR이고 non-serious(EU)라 **90일**이다.
- A: 반응 없는 투약 오류는 ICSR이 아니고, 직업 노출은 EU 정의에 들어간다.
- C: 허가 외 사용도 EU 정의에 들어간다.
- D: 입원은 serious라 15일이다.

bank.title: EU ICSR timelines
bank.stem: Under Article 107(3) of Directive 2001/83, what are the MAH's ICSR timelines?
options: Serious reactions occurring in the EU within 15 days; non-serious reactions from any country within 90 days.
Fatal reactions within 7 days; other serious reactions within 15 days; non-serious ones within 30 days.
Serious and unexpected reactions within 15 days; other reactions are summarised in the PSUR.
Serious (EU and third-country) within 15 days; non-serious occurring in the EU within 90 days.
bank.expl:
- D: **serious**(EU **및 제3국**) **15일**, **non-serious**(EU 발생) **90일**이다.
- A: 지역이 뒤바뀌었다. 제3국 serious가 15일 대상이고, non-serious는 EU 발생분이다.
- B: 7일은 임상(SUSAR) 시계다.
- C: serious AND unexpected는 미국 314.80 조건이다.

bank.title: EudraVigilance single reporting
bank.stem: A serious case occurs in Germany for a nationally authorised product. The MAH's new case processor asks where to send the ICSR under the system in place since 22 November 2017. What is the answer?
options: To both EudraVigilance and each national competent authority, to ensure completeness.
To each national competent authority where the case occurred, which forwards them to EMA.
To the PSUR Repository, which feeds EudraVigilance after PRAC review.
To EudraVigilance, from which national authorities receive the data.
bank.expl:
- D: **2017-11-22** 신 EV 가동 후 MAH는 **EV에만** 보고한다(NCA 중복 보고 폐지). 형식은 E2B(R3)다.
- A·B: NCA 직접·이중 보고가 폐지 대상이었다.
- C: PSUR Repository는 PSUR 제출 창구다.

bank.title: literature monitoring in the EU
bank.stem: An MAH's active substance is not on EMA's medical literature monitoring list. What literature duty applies to the MAH?
options: The MAH runs its own searches, at least weekly, and reports valid cases as ICSRs.
The MAH relies on the national competent authority to search local journals and report cases.
The MAH searches the literature once per PSUR cycle and includes the cases in the PSUR rather than as ICSRs.
The duty passes to EMA, whose literature monitoring service covers the medical journals for each substance.
bank.expl:
- A: EMA **MLM**(2015~)은 **지정 물질·학술지**만 대행한다. 그 밖은 MAH가 **주 1회** 검색하고 유효 사례를 ICSR로 낸다.
- B: 문헌 검색은 MAH 책임이다.
- C: 문헌 사례도 ICSR 시계(15/90일)가 적용된다.
- D: MLM은 지정 범위에 한정된다.

bank.title: literature case with no brand
bank.stem: A published case describes a serious reaction to an active substance but does not identify whose brand was used. Several MAHs market that substance in the EU. Who reports the case?
options: Nobody, because the case lacks an identifiable suspect product.
The MAH of the reference medicinal product, on behalf of the others.
The MAH with the largest market share in the country of occurrence.
Each MAH holding an authorisation for that active substance.
bank.expl:
- D: 문헌 의무는 **활성물질** 기준이다. 브랜드가 특정되지 않으면 **해당 물질 MAH 전부**가 보고한다.
- A: 의심 약은 활성물질로 특정된다.
- B: 참조제 MAH만 보고하는 규정은 없다.
- C: 시장 점유율은 기준이 아니다.

bank.title: GVP module map (1)
bank.stem: Which pairing of GVP module and topic is correct?
options: Module II — risk management systems.
Module VI — management and reporting of ICSRs.
Module IX — post-authorisation safety studies (PASS).
Module V — periodic safety update reports.
bank.expl:
- B: **VI = ICSR** 관리·보고다.
- A: II는 PSMF다.
- C: IX는 신호 관리, PASS는 VIII다.
- D: V는 RMP, PSUR는 VII다.

bank.title: GVP module map (2)
bank.stem: Which GVP module addresses additional risk minimisation measures, and what is its current revision as of the reference date?
options: Module XV, Revision 1 adopted in 2017.
Module X, first version published in 2013.
Module XVI, Rev 3 of 6 August 2024.
Module XII, Revision 2 effective in 2024.
bank.expl:
- C: aRMM은 **GVP XVI**이고 **Rev 3**가 **2024-08-06** 시행이다.
- A: XV는 안전성 소통(DHPC)이다.
- B: X는 추가 모니터링(역삼각)이다.
- D: XI–XIV는 발행되지 않았다.

bank.title: unpublished modules
bank.stem: Which GVP modules were never published as standalone modules?
options: Modules XI to XIV.
Product-specific chapters P.I and P.II.
Modules I to IV.
Modules XV and XVI.
bank.expl:
- A: **XI–XIV는 미발행**이다. 내용은 다른 문서로 흡수됐다.
- B: P.I 백신·P.II 생물의약품은 제품별 고려 장으로 있다.
- C: I(PV 시스템)·II(PSMF)·III(사찰)·IV(감사)는 발행됐다.
- D: XV(안전성 소통)·XVI(aRMM)는 발행됐다.

bank.title: QPPV
bank.stem: A US company preparing its first EU launch proposes that its US head of drug safety, based in New Jersey, act as QPPV. Which statement about the EU qualified person for pharmacovigilance is correct?
options: The QPPV role has a statutory US counterpart under 314.80, called the US safety officer.
The QPPV must reside and operate in the EU/EEA and answers for the whole PV system.
The QPPV is appointed by PRAC for each centrally authorised product at the time of authorisation.
The QPPV may reside anywhere, provided a local contact person exists in each member state.
bank.expl:
- B: **QPPV**(Art 104(3)(a))는 PV 시스템 전체를 책임지는 1인이고 **EU/EEA 거주·활동**, 24/7 연락 가능, 대리인 지정이다.
- A: 미국에는 법정 대응물이 없다.
- C: MAH가 지정한다.
- D: 거주 요건이 있다. 국가 담당자는 일부 회원국의 추가 요구일 뿐이다.

bank.title: PSMF
bank.stem: A national competent authority asks an MAH for its pharmacovigilance system master file ahead of an inspection. The regulatory lead checks what the law requires of the file. Which statement is correct?
options: It is submitted in full in Module 1.8.1 of each MAA and updated afterwards by variation.
Kept in the EU at the QPPV's or main PV site; summarised in Module 1.8.1; provided within 7 days on request.
It is required for centrally authorised products, while nationally authorised products use national files.
It is kept by EMA on behalf of the MAH and provided to inspectors within 30 days of a request.
bank.expl:
- B: **PSMF**(Art 104(3)(b), IR 520/2012 Arts 2–7)는 QPPV 활동지 또는 주 PV 활동지에 두고, **Module 1.8.1에 요약**, 요청 시 **7일 내** 제출한다.
- A: MAA에는 요약만 넣는다.
- C: MAH의 PV 시스템 전체에 대한 문서다.
- D: MAH가 보관한다. 30일은 근거가 없다.

bank.title: QPPV change notification
bank.stem: An MAH's QPPV resigns and the PSMF moves to another member state. How are these changes notified to EU authorities?
options: By a letter to PRAC, which then publishes the change in its monthly meeting minutes.
By updating the Article 57 database, which since 1 February 2016 is the sole notification needed.
By a Type II variation for each marketing authorisation, with assessment before the change takes effect.
By a Type IAIN variation under classification C.8, submitted immediately after implementation.
bank.expl:
- B: 2016-02-01부터 QPPV(연락처 포함)·PSMF 위치 변경은 **Art 57 DB 갱신만**으로 통지한다. variation은 내지 않는다. PSMF logbook도 갱신한다.
- A: PRAC 서신 절차는 없다.
- C: Type II는 대상이 아니다.
- D: QPPV 변경에 C.8 Type IAIN을 쓰지 않는다(2016-02-01부터 Art 57 DB 갱신; C/2025/5045의 C.8은 MAH 변경 후 NAP의 PV 시스템 요약 도입용).

bank.title: PSUR due date (70 days)
bank.stem: A substance has a 1-year PSUR cycle on the EURD list with a data lock point of 31 March. When is the PSUR due?
options: 30 May, 60 days after the data lock point.
29 June, 90 days after the data lock point.
9 June, 70 days after the data lock point.
30 April, 30 days after the data lock point.
bank.expl:
- C: 주기 **≤12개월**이면 DLP 후 **70일**이다. 3월 31일 + 70일 = **6월 9일**(4월 30일, 5월 31일, 6월 9일).
- A·D: 30·60일은 미국 PADER 기한이다.
- B: 90일은 주기가 12개월을 넘을 때다.

bank.title: generic and EURD
bank.stem: A generic (Article 10(1)) MAH finds that the EURD list entry for its substance does not state that generics must submit PSURs. What is its PSUR position?
options: It must submit an abbreviated PSUR at 3-year intervals in place of the full report.
It is exempt from routine PSURs but must implement variations resulting from the PSUSA.
It is exempt from both PSURs and any PSUSA outcome, because it relies on the originator's data.
It must submit PSURs on the same cycle as the originator, because each MA holder for the substance is covered.
bank.expl:
- B: 제네릭·WEU·herbal은 **EURD가 지정하지 않으면 PSUR 면제**다. 그러나 PSUSA 결과 variation은 따라야 한다.
- A: 간소 PSUR 3년 주기 규정은 없다.
- C: 결과 variation은 모든 MA에 적용된다.
- D: 면제 규정이 있다.

bank.title: why substance-based PSUSA
bank.stem: Why did the EU adopt a substance-based PSUR assessment (EURD/PSUSA) while the US keeps product-specific periodic reports?
options: Because EU law treats each brand as a separate active substance, so each needs its own data lock point and assessment.
Because the US does not accept the PBRER format, so FDA cannot align its periodic reports with a substance-based assessment.
Because PRAC assesses innovator products, while generics are left to national authorities under separate national cycles.
One substance sits in many MAs across member states, so a single DLP and assessment cut duplication; the US has one authority.
bank.expl:
- D: 같은 물질이 **수십 개 MA·여러 회원국**에 흩어져 중복되므로 물질 DLP·단일 평가·제네릭 면제로 정리했다(B/R은 물질의 속성). 미국은 단일 당국·제품별 승인이다.
- A: 반대다. 물질 단위로 묶는 것이 핵심이다.
- B: 미국은 waiver로 PBRER를 받는다.
- C: PSUSA 결과는 제네릭 포함 모든 MA에 적용된다.

bank.title: RMP vs REMS trigger
bank.stem: A US company entering the EU assumes it will need a risk management plan only if PRAC identifies a specific risk, as it experienced with FDA and REMS. Which statement contrasts the EU RMP and the US REMS correctly?
options: An RMP is needed for each new MAA (simplified for generics); a REMS only when necessary.
Both are required for each new application, and REMS is simply the US name for the same document.
A REMS is required for each new NDA, while an RMP is required for products under additional monitoring.
Both are required when the authority finds them necessary to ensure that benefits outweigh risks.
bank.expl:
- A: **RMP는 모든 신규 MAA에 필수**(Art 8(3)(iaa), 제네릭 간소)이고, **REMS는 필요할 때만**(505-1)이다.
- B: REMS는 RMP Part V의 추가 조치에 대응할 뿐 같은 문서가 아니다.
- C: 두 지역이 뒤바뀌었다.
- D: RMP는 필요 여부를 따지지 않는다.

bank.title: PASS category
bank.stem: A marketing authorisation is granted with a condition under Article 21a of Directive 2001/83. The condition obliges the MAH to run a non-interventional registry to characterise long-term safety. How is this study classified in the RMP, and what governance follows?
options: A US-style PMR; the MAH reports progress annually to EMA under the equivalent of section 506B.
Category 1 imposed PASS; the protocol needs PRAC approval and the final report is due within 12 months of study end.
Category 3 PASS, because non-interventional registries cannot be imposed as a condition of authorisation.
Category 3 voluntary PASS; the MAH designs it and reports results through the RMP and PSUR without protocol approval.
bank.expl:
- B: Art 21a/22a로 부과된 연구는 **category 1**이다. 프로토콜은 **PRAC 승인(60일)**, 최종 보고는 **12개월 내**다.
- A: PMR·506B는 미국 제도다.
- C: 비개입 레지스트리도 부과될 수 있다. 교과서의 PASS 설계 예가 레지스트리다.
- D: category 3는 RMP 상 자발 연구다. 허가 조건이면 부과된 연구다.

bank.title: RMP structure
bank.stem: In the EU RMP (GVP Module V), which part contains the important identified risks, important potential risks and missing information?
options: Part II, safety specification.
Part I, product overview.
Part III, pharmacovigilance plan.
Part V, risk minimisation measures.
bank.expl:
- A: **Part II 안전성 명세**에 중요 확인·잠재 위험과 missing information이 들어간다.
- B: Part I은 제품 개요다.
- C: Part III은 일상·추가 PV 활동(PASS)이다.
- D: Part V는 일상·추가 위험 최소화 조치다.

bank.title: signal process for a CAP
bank.stem: PRAC validates a signal of serious skin reactions for a centrally authorised product and requests the MAH's assessment. After PRAC issues its recommendation for a labeling change, what is the usual next sequence?
options: The European Commission decides first; PRAC then validates the signal and assesses the MAH response.
CHMP adopts the recommendation; the MAH submits a variation; the European Commission decides.
CMDh adopts the recommendation; each member state issues a separate decision for the CAP.
The MAH updates the SmPC directly and notifies EMA in the next PSUR, without any variation.
bank.expl:
- B: 신호 흐름은 탐지 → validation → 평가 요청 → **PRAC 권고 → CHMP(CAP) → MAH variation → EC 결정**이다(IR 520/2012 Arts 18–24, GVP IX).
- A: 순서가 뒤집혔다.
- C: CMDh는 국가 허가 제품 쪽이다. CAP는 CHMP를 거친다.
- D: 라벨 변경은 variation으로 낸다.

bank.title: MAH EudraVigilance monitoring duty
bank.stem: An MAH's PV head says that monitoring EudraVigilance data is still a voluntary pilot for companies, as it was from 2018. On 1 September 2026, what is the correct position?
options: The pilot continues, with MAHs of products under additional monitoring taking part voluntarily.
Since 12 August 2025, under Regulation 2025/1466, EudraVigilance monitoring is an obligation for MAHs.
The pilot ends on 12 February 2027, when the remaining provisions of Regulation 2025/1466 apply.
EMA alone monitors EudraVigilance, so MAHs hold a reporting role but not a monitoring role.
bank.expl:
- B: **IR 2025/1466**의 EV 모니터링 조항은 **2025-08-12** 적용이다. pilot이 끝나고 **모든 MAH의 의무**가 됐다.
- A: pilot은 종료됐다.
- C: 나머지 조항 적용일은 **2026-02-12**다. 날짜와 대상이 틀렸다.
- D: MAH 모니터링 의무가 있다.

bank.title: Regulation 2025/1466 dates
bank.stem: Which set of dates for Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1466 is correct?
options: In force 22 July 2025; monitoring provisions from 12 August 2025; most others from 12 February 2026.
Entry into force 12 August 2025; the remaining provisions apply from 22 July 2026 onward.
Entry into force 1 February 2016; most other provisions apply from 12 February 2026.
Entry into force 22 November 2017; EudraVigilance monitoring provisions apply from 12 August 2025.
bank.expl:
- A: IR 2025/1466은 **2025-07-22 발효**, EV 모니터링 조항 **2025-08-12**, 나머지 대부분 **2026-02-12** 적용이다.
- B: 날짜를 섞었다.
- C: 2016-02-01은 QPPV·PSMF 변경을 Art 57 DB만으로 통지하게 된 날이다.
- D: 2017-11-22는 신 EudraVigilance 가동일이다.

bank.title: black triangle scope
bank.stem: A company receives EU approval for a biosimilar monoclonal antibody whose active substance was first authorised in the EU in 2008. Does additional monitoring (the black triangle) apply?
options: No, because biosimilars are covered by the reference product's additional monitoring status.
Yes, but just if PRAC imposes a PASS, which is the trigger for biologics.
Yes, because biologicals, including biosimilars, are subject to it.
No, because the active substance was authorised before 1 January 2011.
bank.expl:
- C: Reg 726/2004 Art 23은 **모든 생물의약품**(바이오시밀러 포함)을 추가 모니터링 대상으로 둔다.
- A: 각 제품에 표시한다.
- B: PASS 부과는 여러 발동 사유 중 하나다.
- D: 2011-01-01 기준은 **신 활성물질** 요건이다. 생물의약품은 그 기준과 별개로 대상이다.

bank.title: black triangle duration and meaning
bank.stem: Which statement about the EU black triangle is correct?
options: It lasts 10 years and is removed by the MAH at the first renewal of the marketing authorisation.
It encourages reporting, lasts 5 years for new substances and biologicals, and has no US equivalent.
It warns that the product has a confirmed safety problem, and it must appear in promotional materials.
It applies to centrally authorised products and is mirrored in the US by the boxed warning.
bank.expl:
- B: 역삼각은 **보고 촉진** 표시이고, 신 활성물질·생물은 **5년**(또는 조건 충족까지)이며, **미국 대응물이 없다**.
- A: 기간은 5년이다. 해제는 PRAC이 정한다.
- C: 안전 문제 표시가 아니고, 홍보 자료에는 넣지 않는다.
- D: Dir 2001/83 Art 11로 국가 허가 제품에도 적용된다. boxed warning은 위험 경고다.

bank.title: Article 107i
bank.stem: A member state considers suspending a nationally authorised product because of a new cardiac risk from pharmacovigilance data. Which EU procedure must start, and how does it run?
options: Article 20 of Regulation 726/2004; the European Commission suspends the product without PRAC involvement.
Article 107i urgent Union procedure: PRAC assessment, then CMDh or CHMP, then national or EC action.
A Type II variation initiated by the member state; the MAH has 60 days to respond before suspension.
Article 30 harmonisation referral; CHMP assesses, and the outcome binds just the referring member state.
bank.expl:
- B: PV 근거로 정지·철회 등을 검토하면 **Art 107i 긴급 연합 절차**가 의무 발동한다. **PRAC**(공청회 가능) → **CMDh**(국가 제품) 또는 **CHMP** → 각국 이행 또는 EC 결정이다. 회원국은 잠정 정지할 수 있다.
- A: Art 20은 CAP 대상 절차이고 PRAC을 거친다.
- C: 회원국이 variation을 시작하는 구조가 아니다.
- D: Art 30은 조화 절차로 안전성 근거 절차가 아니다.

bank.title: EU record retention
bank.stem: An MAH withdraws its marketing authorisation in 2026. Under Article 12 of Implementing Regulation 520/2012, how long must it keep the ICSR documentation for that product?
options: Until 2031, 5 years after the authorisation ceases.
Until 2056, 30 years after the authorisation has ceased.
Until 2036, 10 years after the authorisation ceases.
Until 2028, 2 years after the authorisation ceases.
bank.expl:
- C: IR 520/2012 **Art 12**: ICSR 문서는 MA 종료 후 **10년**이다. 2026 + 10 = **2036**.
- A: 5년은 **PSMF·PV 시스템 기록**(시스템 공식 종료 후)이다.
- B: 30년은 ATMP 공여자 추적성이다.
- D: 2년은 미국 IND 기록(312.57)이다.

bank.title: ICH E2 family
bank.stem: Which pairing of ICH guideline and subject is correct?
options: E2D — postmarketing safety data; spontaneous reports carry presumed causality.
E2E — electronic transmission of individual case safety reports (ICSRs).
E2C(R2) — development safety update report submitted annually during clinical development.
E2F — periodic benefit-risk evaluation report for marketed products.
bank.expl:
- A: **E2D**(2003)는 시판 후 안전성 정의·보고이고, 자발 보고는 **인과성 추정**이다.
- B: E2E는 PV planning이다. 전자 전송은 E2B(R3)다.
- C: E2C(R2)는 PBRER다. DSUR는 E2F다.
- D: E2F는 DSUR다.

bank.title: which E2 guideline underlies 312.32
bank.stem: A US sponsor and an EU sponsor both trace their 7-day and 15-day clinical expedited reporting timelines to the same ICH guideline. Which guideline is it?
options: ICH E2C(R2), which covers expedited and periodic reports together.
ICH E2E, which defines expedited reporting as part of PV planning.
ICH E2B(R3), which sets the reporting clocks for each data element.
ICH E2A, on clinical safety definitions and expedited reporting.
bank.expl:
- D: **E2A**(1994)가 임상 안전성 정의와 **7/15일** 신속 보고의 근간이다. 312.32와 CTR SUSAR가 이를 따른다.
- A: E2C(R2)는 PBRER다.
- B: E2E는 PV planning이다.
- C: E2B(R3)는 전송 형식이다.

bank.title: MedDRA and VigiBase
bank.stem: Which statement about global pharmacovigilance tools is correct?
options: VigiBase is EMA's database that replaced EudraVigilance for third-country cases.
MedDRA is maintained by the MSSO and released twice a year, in March and September.
VigiBase was created by FDAAA in 2007 as part of the Sentinel network.
MedDRA is maintained by WHO and released once a year, together with the VigiBase update.
bank.expl:
- B: **MedDRA**는 **MSSO**가 관리하고 **연 2회(3월·9월)** 버전이 나온다.
- A: VigiBase는 WHO UMC의 국제 DB다.
- C: VigiBase는 1968년 WHO 국제 모니터링 프로그램에서 시작했다.
- D: WHO가 관리하는 것은 VigiBase다.

bank.title: adding Japan
bank.stem: A product approved in the US and EU is now approved in Japan. A serious reaction already described in the Japanese package insert occurs. What is the Japanese ICSR timeline, and what post-approval review applies to a new active ingredient?
options: 90 days; re-examination period of 10 years.
30 days; re-examination period of 8 years.
15 days; re-examination period of 4 years.
15 days; re-examination period of 8 years.
bank.expl:
- B: 일본은 **기지(첨부문서 기재) 중대 반응 30일**이고, 신 유효성분 **재심사는 8년**이다.
- A: 90일은 EU non-serious 기한이고, 10년은 희귀의약품 재심사다.
- C: 15일은 사망·미지 중대 반응 등이다. 4년은 일부 제품의 짧은 재심사 기간이다.
- D: 15일은 미지 중대 반응의 기한이다.

bank.title: three-region minimum system
bank.stem: A company launches its first product in the US, EU and Japan at the same time. Which set of legal PV roles is correct?
options: A single QPPV based in the US who covers the three regions under one PSMF accepted by FDA, EMA and PMDA alike.
EU QPPV (EEA-resident) and PSMF; a US safety contact, as US law has no QPPV; a Japanese safety management supervisor.
A QPPV in each of the three regions, each registered in the Article 57 database and backed by a regional PSMF.
A QPPV in the EU and an FDA-registered US QPPV under 314.80; Japan relies on the EU QPPV through mutual recognition.
bank.expl:
- B: EU는 **QPPV(EEA 거주)+PSMF**, 미국은 법정 QPPV 없이 **314.80 safety contact**, 일본은 **안전관리책임자**다.
- A: QPPV는 EU/EEA 거주 요건이 있고, PSMF는 EU 문서다.
- C: Art 57 DB는 EU 제품 정보다. 미국·일본에는 QPPV 제도가 없다.
- D: 미국 법정 QPPV는 없고, 일본은 자체 책임자를 둔다.

bank.title: why the expedited rules differ
bank.stem: Why does the US expedite only serious and unexpected cases while the EU expedites all serious cases, and what does this imply for a global safety unit?
options: The US rule exists because FDA lacks a database for expected events. A global unit should send expected serious US cases to the EU and leave them out of US reports.
The US distrusts spontaneous data and the EU does not. A global unit should apply the US rule worldwide, since it produces fewer expedited reports.
The USPI lists known risks, so 15-day reports target new information; EudraVigilance needs every serious case for signals. One 15-day SOP is safest.
The EU applies expectedness against the SmPC at submission. A global unit should assess each case against the SmPC first and the USPI second, then decide.
bank.expl:
- C: 미국은 **USPI = 알려진 위험 목록**이라 15-day는 새 정보 탐지용이고, EU는 **EV를 신호 탐지 엔진**으로 쓰기 때문에 모든 serious를 넣는다. 그래서 **최단 15일 단일 SOP**로 처리하고 미국 periodic 분류를 붙인다.
- A: 라벨에 있는 serious 사례도 미국 periodic 보고와 AEMS에 들어간다.
- B: 미국 기준만 쓰면 EU 15일 의무를 놓친다.
- D: EU ICSR 제출 요건에는 예상성이 없다.

bank.title: MSC-EV product RMP
bank.stem: An allogeneic MSC-EV product is about to receive EU approval, and PRAC will impose a prospective registry as a condition of the authorisation. No thromboembolic case has been seen in the clinical programme. In drafting the RMP, how should the team place thromboembolism and use in pregnancy in Part II, and what PV plan fits?
options: Both as missing information; a category 3 voluntary PASS, because registry studies cannot be imposed on cell-derived products.
Thromboembolism omitted until a case is reported; pregnancy as an identified risk; a REMS-style ETASU in place of an RMP.
Thromboembolism as an important potential risk and pregnancy as missing information; the registry as a category 1 PASS, with the black triangle for 5 years.
Thromboembolism as an important identified risk and pregnancy as an important potential risk; routine PV alone, because the product is not a new active substance.
bank.expl:
- C: 교과서 설계는 **혈전·색전 = 중요 잠재 위험**(EV 응고 촉진 가능성), **임신·수유 = missing information**이다. 허가 조건으로 부과된 레지스트리는 **category 1 PASS**이고, 생물의약품이므로 **역삼각 5년**이다.
- A: 부과된 레지스트리는 category 1이다.
- B: 이론적 위험도 잠재 위험으로 미리 둔다. EU는 RMP가 필수다.
- D: 사례가 없으므로 확인 위험이 아니다. 생물의약품은 신 활성물질 여부와 무관하게 추가 모니터링 대상이다.

bank.title: fatal stroke, background-common event
bank.stem: In an ongoing US Phase 3 trial, a site reports a fatal stroke in a 70-year-old subject. Stroke is not listed in the Investigator's Brochure, and strokes are common in this age group. How should the sponsor decide on IND safety reporting?
options: Report within 15 days, because the investigator's causality opinion alone determines reportability.
Report within 7 days, because any fatal event not listed in the IB is reportable without further assessment.
Do not report, because strokes in elderly subjects are excluded from IND safety reporting by regulation.
Judge reasonable possibility from aggregate analysis against the control arm before deciding on a report.
bank.expl:
- D: 312.32의 suspected adverse reaction은 **reasonable possibility**가 있어야 한다. 배경 질환에서 흔한 사건(70세 뇌졸중)은 위약·대조군 대비 **집계 분석**(2012·2021 guidance)으로 판단하고, 가능성이 있으면 치명·예상 밖이므로 7일 보고다.
- A: 시험자 의견만으로 정하지 않는다. sponsor가 집계 근거로 판단하고, 치명이면 시계는 15일이 아니라 7일이다.
- B: 예상 밖·치명만으로는 부족하다. reasonable possibility 판단이 먼저다.
- C: 배제 규정은 없다. 가능성이 없다고 판단해도 DSUR·집계 모니터링에 기록한다.

bank.title: single-case type, day count
bank.stem: A sponsor learns on June 2 of a fatal acute liver failure in a Phase 2 subject with no alternative cause. Liver injury is not in the IB. By when is the initial IND safety report due to FDA?
options: June 9, but after the data monitoring committee has first unblinded the full treatment arm.
June 30, at the next IND annual report, because a single case cannot establish causality.
June 9, as a 7-day report that may be made by telephone, fax or E2B and then completed.
June 17, as a 15-day report, because the 7-day clock is reserved for life-threatening events.
bank.expl:
- C: 간 손상은 **단일 사례로도** reasonable possibility를 둘 수 있는 유형이다. 치명·예상 밖이므로 **7일** 초기 보고(전화·팩스·E2B) 후 완결한다. June 2 + 7일 = June 9.
- A: 맹검 해제는 **보고 사례만** 한다. 군 전체 해제는 요구되지 않는다.
- B: 단일 사례 유형은 연례 보고로 미루지 않는다.
- D: 7일 시계는 **치명 또는 생명위협**에 적용된다. 사망은 7일이다.

bank.title: what is NOT a 15-day IND trigger
bank.stem: Which of the following is NOT a trigger for a 15-day IND safety report under 21 CFR 312.32?
options: A clinically important increase in the rate of serious suspected adverse reactions.
A serious suspected adverse reaction that is already listed in the IB at the observed severity.
A serious and unexpected suspected adverse reaction that is not fatal or life-threatening.
Findings from animal or in vitro studies that suggest a significant risk for human trial subjects.
bank.expl:
- B: IB에 같은 중증도로 기재된 사건은 **예상된** 사건이라 15일 개별 보고 대상이 아니다. 발생률이 임상적으로 중요하게 늘면 그때 보고한다.
- A: serious SAR 발생률의 임상적으로 중요한 증가도 15일이다.
- C: serious·예상 밖 SAR은 15일 보고 대상이다.
- D: 동물·시험관 소견이 중대 위험을 시사하면 15일이다.

bank.title: EU CTR fatal SUSAR
bank.stem: A fatal SUSAR occurs in an EU trial authorised under the Clinical Trials Regulation. Expectedness was assessed against the reference safety information in the IB. What is the sponsor's reporting obligation?
options: Report to EudraVigilance (CT module) within 7 days, with follow-up within a further 8 days.
Report to EudraVigilance within 15 days, because the 7-day clock is a US IND rule with no CTR equivalent.
Report to the national competent authority within 15 days, using the SmPC as the expectedness reference.
Report through CTIS in the annual safety report, because single fatal cases are aggregated.
bank.expl:
- A: CTR **Art 42**: 치명·생명위협 SUSAR은 sponsor가 **EVCTM**으로 **7일** 내, 이후 **8일** 내 완결한다. 예상성은 **RSI** 기준이다.
- B: EU에도 7일 시계가 있다. 15일은 치명·생명위협이 아닌 SUSAR이다.
- C: 제출처는 국가별이 아니라 EudraVigilance이고, 예상성 기준은 SmPC가 아니라 RSI다.
- D: Art 43 ASR은 연 1회 집계 보고이고 개별 SUSAR을 대신하지 않는다.

bank.title: CTR article mapping
bank.stem: Which pairing of an EU Clinical Trials Regulation provision with its timeline is correct?
options: Art 52 serious breach — 15 days; Art 54 urgent safety measure — 7 days.
Art 41 investigator to sponsor — 7 days; Art 42 non-fatal SUSAR — 7 days.
Art 53 unexpected event — 7 days; Art 43 annual safety report — twice a year.
Art 52 serious breach — 7 days; Art 54 urgent safety measure — 7 days.
bank.expl:
- D: **Art 52** serious breach **7일**, **Art 54** urgent safety measure 후 **7일** 내 통지다.
- A: serious breach는 15일이 아니라 7일이다. 15일은 Art 53이다.
- B: Art 41은 시험자→sponsor **즉시**이고, 치명·생명위협이 아닌 SUSAR은 **15일**이다.
- C: Art 53은 **15일**이고, Art 43 ASR은 **연 1회**다.

bank.title: reference document in a new-indication trial
bank.stem: A drug approved in the US for hypertension is being studied under IND for heart failure. A serious event occurs that is listed in the USPI but not in the IB reference safety information. Which document determines expectedness for IND safety reporting?
options: The IB reference safety information, so the event is assessed as unexpected for the trial.
The USPI, because an approved label overrides the IB for any marketed active substance.
The CCSI, because a single global reference is used for expectedness in both trials and practice.
The EU SmPC, because it is the most comprehensive label among the approved versions.
bank.expl:
- A: 임상 SUSAR·312.32 expectedness는 승인 라벨이 아니라 **IB의 RSI**로 판단한다. IB에 없으면 예상 밖이다.
- B: USPI는 시판 후 314.80 expectedness 기준이다. IB 대신 USPI를 쓰는 것이 교과서의 대표 오류 패턴이다.
- C: CCSI는 PSUR/PBRER **listedness** 기준이다.
- D: SmPC는 미국 IND 판단 기준이 아니다.

bank.title: listed in SmPC, not in USPI
bank.stem: A spontaneous serious hepatic event from Germany is listed in the EU SmPC but not in the USPI. The product is marketed in both regions. What reporting follows?
options: Neither is expedited, because the CCSI governs expectedness for both US and EU individual case reports.
